words.exZh: 佩奇你看，泥坑又回来了！快点，乔治，我们去拿靴子！

words.ex: Um, maybe if I just switch it off and then switch it on again.
words.exZh: 嗯，也许我只要把它关掉，然后再打开就行了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: And that little apple tree will grow into a big apple tree, like this.
words.exZh: 然后那棵小苹果树会长成一棵大苹果树，就像这样。

words.ex: Oh, George! Oh, the noise is George. He was so tired, he has fallen asleep.
words.exZh: 哦，乔治！哦，原来是乔治的声音。他太累了，已经睡着了。

words.ex: Don't worry, Peppa. Next time you come, the seed will have grown into a plant.
words.exZh: 别担心，佩奇。下次你们来的时候，种子就长成植株了。

words.ex: The Sleepy Princess. It is nighttime. Peppa and George are going to bed.
words.exZh: 瞌睡公主。晚上了，佩奇和乔治要上床睡觉了。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: A detective is a very important person who is good at finding things.
words.exZh: 侦探是很重要的人，擅长找东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Good. Anyway, now the pumpkin is broken, I can make it into pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 很好。反正南瓜已经坏了，我可以把它做成南瓜派。

words.ex: This old boat can go faster than your rusty bucket any day, Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 猪爷爷，我这艘老船哪天都比你那艘锈桶跑得快！

words.ex: Ooh, what is the present? It's got wheels! Car! It's not a car, George!
words.exZh: 哦，礼物是什么呢？它有轮子！汽车！乔治，那不是汽车！

words.ex: George likes helping Mummy make cookies, but he likes playing with Peppa more.
words.exZh: 乔治喜欢帮妈妈做饼干，但他更喜欢和佩奇一起玩。

words.ex: Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game. George is our patient. Oh, I see.
words.exZh: 别担心，爸爸。这只是个游戏。乔治是我们的病人。哦，我明白了。

words.ex: Chocolate cake! My word, George seems to have got his appetite back!
words.exZh: 巧克力蛋糕！哎呀，乔治好像又有胃口了！

words.ex: George, you've done it all wrong. I know a better way to cure hiccups.
words.exZh: 乔治，你全做错了。我知道一个更好的治打嗝办法。

words.ex: Everything in my garden grows from tiny seeds like these.
words.exZh: 我花园里的每一样东西，都是从这样的小种子长出来的。

words.ex: No more red spots, you're completely better! Aren't I still a bit ill?
words.exZh: 红斑点都没了，你完全好了！我还算有点病吧？

words.ex: Peppa, first we need tomatoes. I can see them! I can see them!
words.exZh: 佩奇，首先我们需要西红柿。我看见啦！我看见啦！

words.ex: The Sleepy Princess. It is nighttime. Peppa and George are going to bed.
words.exZh: 瞌睡公主。晚上了，佩奇和乔治要上床睡觉了。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: It's only mud. Let's clean up quickly before Mummy sees the mess.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。我们赶紧清理干净，别让妈妈看到这团乱。

words.ex: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

words.ex: Hello Susie! Hello Peppa! Susie Sheep has come to play with Peppa.
words.exZh: 你好，苏西！你好，佩奇！小羊苏西来和佩奇一起玩了。

words.ex: Mmm, delicious. I'm going to hide mine in my tummy. Me, too!
words.exZh: 嗯，真好吃。我要把我的藏进肚子里。我也要！

words.ex: I'm sorry I called you a sea dog, Granddad. Say sorry to Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 对不起，我不该叫你老水狗，狗爷爷。跟猪爷爷道歉！

words.ex: Suzy Sheep, Danny Dog and Rebecca Rabbit are playing on the slide.
words.exZh: 小羊苏西、小狗丹尼和小兔瑞贝卡在玩滑梯。

words.ex: Captain Grandpa never says anything silly! Of course not! Captain Grandpa!
words.exZh: 船长爷爷从来不说傻话！那是当然！船长爷爷！

words.ex: I want to eat, then have a nap. I certainly don't want to run around.
words.exZh: 我想吃东西，然后睡个午觉。我可不想跑来跑去。

words.ex: Never mind, George, you can share Daddy's ice cream. I'm sure he won't mind.
words.exZh: 没关系，乔治，你可以分爸爸的冰淇淋吃。我肯定他不会介意的。

words.ex: The Tooth Fairy. Peppa and George are having their favorite food: spaghetti.
words.exZh: 牙仙。佩奇和乔治在吃他们最喜欢的食物：意大利面。

words.ex: Hooray! Mummy, now that we're all muddy, can we jump in the puddle?
words.exZh: 太好啦！妈妈，既然我们都已经一身泥了，我们能跳泥坑吗？

words.ex: The detective could try and guess where Mr. Dinosaur might be.
words.exZh: 侦探可以试着猜猜恐龙先生可能在哪里。

words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Happy birthday, Peppa! Thank you, everyone! This is my best birthday ever!
words.exZh: 生日快乐，佩奇！谢谢大家！这是我过得最棒的一个生日！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Camping. Peppa and her family are going camping. I love camping!
words.exZh: 露营。佩奇一家要去露营。我喜欢露营！

words.ex: Wow, it's so tall. Let's go inside. The view from the top is fantastic.
words.exZh: 哇，它好高啊。我们进去吧。从顶上看出去的风景美极了。

words.ex: Peppa looks under the newspaper, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
words.exZh: 佩奇在报纸下面找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。

words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Peppa and George loved to watch Mummy work on the computer.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治很喜欢看妈妈在电脑上工作。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: We can play Happy Mrs. Chicken later, but now I have to work.
words.exZh: 我们晚一点可以玩《快乐的鸡太太》，但现在我得工作。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: George, be careful not to knock anything over. It's not funny.
words.exZh: 乔治，小心别把东西碰倒了。这可不好笑。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: And that little apple tree will grow into a big apple tree, like this.
words.exZh: 然后那棵小苹果树会长成一棵大苹果树，就像这样。

words.exZh: 乔治，你全做错了。我知道一个更好的治打嗝办法。

words.ex: Suzy Sheep, Danny Dog and Rebecca Rabbit are playing on the slide.
words.exZh: 小羊苏西、小狗丹尼和小兔瑞贝卡在玩滑梯。

words.ex: How do you feel? I'm not very well, Suzy. I have to stay in bed.
words.exZh: 你感觉怎么样？苏西，我不太舒服。我得躺在床上。

words.ex: Oh! Daddy Pig is looking in the wheelbarrow. Peppa's shoes are not there.
words.exZh: 哦！猪爸爸在手推车里找。佩奇的鞋子不在那儿。

words.ex: We can play Happy Mrs. Chicken later, but now I have to work.
words.exZh: 我们晚一点可以玩《快乐的鸡太太》，但现在我得工作。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.exZh: 船长爷爷从来不说傻话！那是当然！船长爷爷！

words.ex: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
words.exZh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

words.ex: We follow the main road and look out for Windy Castle. As I thought.
words.exZh: 我们沿着大路走，留意风车城堡。果然不出我所料。

words.ex: The sun is very hot, so Peppa and George have to have sun cream on.
words.exZh: 太阳很晒，所以佩奇和乔治必须涂上防晒霜。

words.ex: Everyone loves chocolate coins. Granny, Grandpa, this is the best treasure hunt ever!
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢巧克力币。奶奶，爷爷，这是最棒的一次寻宝游戏！

words.ex: It worked! Now Daddy Pig has his pancake. Daddy has a pancake on his head!
words.exZh: 成功了！现在猪爸爸拿到他的煎饼了。爸爸头上顶着一张煎饼！

words.ex: Uh, Peppa, George, forget what I just said about Uncle Pig. Okay, Daddy.
words.exZh: 呃，佩奇，乔治，忘了我刚才说的关于猪叔叔的话。好的，爸爸。

words.ex: Daddy Pig wears glasses. He needs to wear glasses to see clearly.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸戴眼镜。他需要戴眼镜才能看清楚。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Look, Grandpa. There's a little frog. Why don't you play at being frogs?
words.exZh: 爷爷，看。有一只小青蛙。你们为什么不扮青蛙呢？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Granny, please can we leave the table and go and see Polly Parrot?
words.exZh: 奶奶，我们可以离开餐桌去看波莉鹦鹉吗？

words.ex: I'm sure they've had enough. Sorry, Mrs. Duck, we've no more bread.
words.exZh: 我相信它们已经吃饱了。对不起，鸭太太，我们没有面包了。

words.ex: Lunchtime, everyone! Coming! After lunch, we'll do a puppet show. Hooray!
words.exZh: 开饭啦，大家！来啦！吃完午饭，我们就来演木偶戏。太好啦！

words.ex: George, you've done it all wrong. I know a better way to cure hiccups.

words.exZh: 船长爷爷从来不说傻话！那是当然！船长爷爷！

words.exZh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

words.ex: Now it's my turn. This is Mummy's dress. This is Mummy's hat.
words.exZh: 现在轮到我了。这是妈妈的裙子。这是妈妈的帽子。

words.ex: I'm sorry I called you a sea dog, Granddad. Say sorry to Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 对不起，我不该叫你老水狗，狗爷爷。跟猪爷爷道歉！

words.ex: Peppa has made a snowball. Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
words.exZh: 佩奇团了一个雪球。佩奇和乔治玩得非常开心。

words.ex: Hooray! Mummy, now that we're all muddy, can we jump in the puddle?
words.exZh: 太好啦！妈妈，既然我们都已经一身泥了，我们能跳泥坑吗？

words.ex: The detective could try and guess where Mr. Dinosaur might be.
words.exZh: 侦探可以试着猜猜恐龙先生可能在哪里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: George always has Mr. Dinosaur in his bed at night. So, that's where he is.
words.exZh: 乔治晚上总是把恐龙先生放在床上。所以，他就在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: I wonder if this time you threw Mr. Dinosaur just a bit too high.
words.exZh: 我在想，这次你是不是把他抛得太高了一点。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Good idea! Let's see who can tidy up first. Ready, steady, go!
words.exZh: 好主意！看谁先收拾完。各就各位，预备，开始！

words.ex: Silly magic Daddy, you said all three colours! Shush, Peppa, don't tell anyone!
words.exZh: 傻乎乎的魔术师爸爸，你把三个颜色全说了一遍！嘘，佩奇，别告诉别人！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: George is having fun making bubbles, and Peppa is having fun popping them!
words.exZh: 乔治开心地吹泡泡，佩奇开心地戳泡泡！

words.ex: Dinosaur. A dinosaur? Uh, how about a tiger instead? I'm good at tigers.
words.exZh: 恐龙。恐龙？呃，要不画老虎吧？我擅长画老虎。

words.ex: The sun is very hot, so Peppa and George have to have sun cream on.
words.exZh: 太阳很晒，所以佩奇和乔治必须涂上防晒霜。

words.ex: Granny, please can we leave the table and go and see Polly Parrot?
words.exZh: 奶奶，我们可以离开餐桌去看波莉鹦鹉吗？

words.ex: George should have another turn, but George isn't very good at hiding.
words.exZh: 乔治应该再玩一次，但乔治不太会躲。

words.ex: You're doing really well, Peppa. Hold on, Daddy. Just keep pedaling.
words.exZh: 你做得非常好，佩奇。抓紧，爸爸。继续踩踏板。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you're holding the map upside down! Yes, I thought as much.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你把地图拿反了！是的，我也觉得是。

words.ex: One penny and two buttons! Here's your change, one button! Thank you, Mr. Fox!
words.exZh: 一枚便士和两颗纽扣！这是找你的钱，一颗纽扣！谢谢你，狐狸先生！

words.ex: Suzy Sheep, Danny Dog and Rebecca Rabbit are playing on the slide.
words.exZh: 小羊苏西、小狗丹尼和小兔瑞贝卡在玩滑梯。

words.ex: I hope the wasp doesn't sting Daddy. Oh, get away, you little pest!
words.exZh: 希望黄蜂别蜇到爸爸。哦，走开，你这个小讨厌鬼！

words.ex: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

words.zh: 是；明白（水手答语 aye aye）
words.ex: The main thing is... aye... I won the race, Grandpa Pig! Naughty Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 重要的是……哎呀……我赢了比赛，猪爷爷！调皮的猪爷爷！

words.ex: But I want to play with the big children, not George and his toy dinosaur.
words.exZh: 可我想和大孩子们一起玩，不是乔治和他的玩具恐龙。

words.ex: George, so the rules say I win. Now it's my turn. I win again!
words.exZh: 乔治，按规则算我赢了。现在轮到我了。我又赢啦！

words.ex: The Playground. Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends.
words.exZh: 游乐场。佩奇和乔治和朋友们在游乐场。

words.ex: Daddy Pig has made his own bubble mixture! Come on, everyone!
words.exZh: 猪爸爸自己做了一盆泡泡水！大家快来！

words.ex: Captain Grandpa never says anything silly! Of course not! Captain Grandpa!
words.exZh: 船长爷爷从来不说傻话！那是当然！船长爷爷！

words.ex: I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
words.exZh: 我肯定他这次会好一点。闭上眼睛开始数数吧。

words.ex: It is home time, and the children's parents are here to pick them up.
words.exZh: 放学时间到了，孩子们的父母来接他们了。

words.ex: Pumpkins are the only thing I can grow. Probably because I love pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 南瓜是我唯一能种出来的东西。大概是因为我太喜欢南瓜派了。

words.ex: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
words.exZh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

words.ex: Goodbye! Daddy Pig is digging in the garden. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George.
words.exZh: 再见！猪爸爸在花园里挖土。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。

words.ex: Look, look, I'm a butterfly. Yes, Peppa. You're a beautiful butterfly.
words.exZh: 看，看，我是一只蝴蝶。是的，佩奇。你是一只漂亮的蝴蝶。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Happy birthday, Peppa! Thank you, everyone! This is my best birthday ever!
words.exZh: 生日快乐，佩奇！谢谢大家！这是我过得最棒的一个生日！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.exZh: 小猫坎迪和小马佩德罗在攀爬架上。你们好！喵！

words.ex: Dinosaur. A dinosaur? Uh, how about a tiger instead? I'm good at tigers.
words.exZh: 恐龙。恐龙？呃，要不画老虎吧？我擅长画老虎。

words.ex: Captain Grandpa never says anything silly! Of course not! Captain Grandpa!
words.exZh: 船长爷爷从来不说傻话！那是当然！船长爷爷！

words.ex: Thank you, Peppa, I think we've all heard that story enough times now! But it's funny!
words.exZh: 谢谢你，佩奇，我觉得这个故事我们已经听得够多啦！不过确实挺好笑的！

words.ex: No, George, the next thing on the list is onions!
words.exZh: 不对，乔治，清单上的下一样是洋葱！

words.ex: Horsey Twinkle Toes. Peppa and George are playing in their bedroom.
words.exZh: 小马闪亮脚趾。佩奇和乔治在他们的卧室里玩。

words.ex: Horsey Twinkle Toes. Peppa and George are playing in their bedroom.
words.exZh: 小马闪亮脚趾。佩奇和乔治在他们的卧室里玩。

words.ex: The Blackberry Bush. Peppa and her family are at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
words.exZh: 黑莓丛。佩奇一家在猪奶奶和猪爷爷家。

words.ex: Oh. Oh, we've looked everywhere, but we can't find Peppa's shoes. Peppa's shoes are lost.
words.exZh: 哦。哦，我们到处都找过了，可就是找不到佩奇的鞋子。佩奇的鞋子丢了。

words.ex: Hello Susie! Hello Peppa! Susie Sheep has come to play with Peppa.
words.exZh: 你好，苏西！你好，佩奇！小羊苏西来和佩奇一起玩了。

words.ex: I'm afraid it doesn't taste very nice. Open wide, please.
words.exZh: 恐怕这药不太好吃。请把嘴张大。

words.ex: But later I will get some exercise, even if no one else does.
words.exZh: 不过待会儿我会去锻炼的，就算别人都不去。

words.ex: What was that strange noise? Peppa, George, quick, come inside the house!
words.exZh: 那是什么奇怪的声音？佩奇，乔治，快，进屋来！

words.ex: I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
words.exZh: 我肯定他这次会好一点。闭上眼睛开始数数吧。

words.ex: George, when I was a little piggy, I used to like playing at being a worm.
words.exZh: 乔治，我小时候也喜欢玩扮蠕虫。
