words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Never mind the pumpkin. The important thing is that you are okay.
words.exZh: 南瓜没关系。重要的是你没事。

words.ex: Oh dear, Daddy Pig cannot see a thing without them, and it makes him very grumpy.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，猪爸爸没有眼镜什么都看不见，这让他脾气很不好。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: It is bath time. Peppa wants to keep her new shoes on, even for her bath.
words.exZh: 洗澡时间到了。佩奇想穿着她的新鞋，连洗澡也不脱。

words.ex: Don't worry, Peppa. Next time you come, the seed will have grown into a plant.
words.exZh: 别担心，佩奇。下次你们来的时候，种子就长成植株了。

words.ex: It is a lovely sunny day, and Peppa and George are riding their bicycles.
words.exZh: 今天阳光明媚，佩奇和乔治在骑他们的自行车。

words.ex: Lunchtime, everyone! Coming! After lunch, we'll do a puppet show. Hooray!
words.exZh: 开饭啦，大家！来啦！吃完午饭，我们就来演木偶戏。太好啦！

words.ex: What? Quick, find something else to catch the water! Well done, Peppa! Easy as pie.
words.exZh: 什么？快点，再找个别的东西来接水！干得好，佩奇！小菜一碟。

words.ex: Now we can heat up the tomato soup. Ah, listen to the sounds of nature.
words.exZh: 现在我们可以热番茄汤了。啊，听听大自然的声音。

words.ex: Mmm, delicious. I'm going to hide mine in my tummy. Me, too!
words.exZh: 嗯，真好吃。我要把我的藏进肚子里。我也要！

words.ex: Hmm, frogs are not as pretty as butterflies or as wiggly as worms.
words.exZh: 嗯，青蛙没有蝴蝶漂亮，也没有蠕虫会扭。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Oh, dear. George does not want to be a worm. He wants to be a butterfly.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。乔治不想扮蠕虫。他想扮蝴蝶。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Quick, George, it's bedtime. We don't want to miss the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 快点，乔治，该睡觉了。我们可不想错过牙仙。

words.ex: Poor Teddy, he's soaking wet! Yes, poor Teddy. Let's get him dry.
words.exZh: 可怜的泰迪，他全身都湿透了！是啊，可怜的泰迪。我们把他弄干吧。

words.ex: I'm going to visit my grandma! I'm going to visit my grandma! Bravo, Peppa!
words.exZh: 我要去看望我的外婆！我要去看望我的外婆！太棒了，佩奇！

words.ex: One penny and two buttons! Here's your change, one button! Thank you, Mr. Fox!
words.exZh: 一枚便士和两颗纽扣！这是找你的钱，一颗纽扣！谢谢你，狐狸先生！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you're holding the map upside down! Yes, I thought as much.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你把地图拿反了！是的，我也觉得是。

words.ex: Um, you say: I'm going to chase you away, you big bad wolf! Um... go away, naughty wolf! Very good, Pedro!
words.exZh: 嗯，你要说：我要把你赶走，你这大灰狼！嗯……走开，坏狼！非常好，佩德罗！

words.ex: Chloé's here! Auntie Pig has brought Chloé to spend the day at Peppa's house.
words.exZh: 克洛伊来啦！猪阿姨把克洛伊带来，在佩奇家玩一天。

words.ex: Peppa quite enjoyed the powercut, but she's happy the electricity is back again!
words.exZh: 佩奇还挺喜欢这次停电的，不过电回来了她也很开心！

words.ex: George is having fun making bubbles, and Peppa is having fun popping them!
words.exZh: 乔治开心地吹泡泡，佩奇开心地戳泡泡！

words.ex: Daddy Pig has made his own bubble mixture! Come on, everyone!
words.exZh: 猪爸爸自己做了一盆泡泡水！大家快来！

words.ex: The Blackberry Bush. Peppa and her family are at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
words.exZh: 黑莓丛。佩奇一家在猪奶奶和猪爷爷家。

words.ex: I'm going to visit my grandma! I'm going to visit my grandma! Bravo, Peppa!
words.exZh: 我要去看望我的外婆！我要去看望我的外婆！太棒了，佩奇！

words.ex: You are a very naughty wolf! I saved you, Grandma! Hooray! Thank you! Bravo! Bravo! Bravo!
words.exZh: 你是一只非常淘气的狼！我把你救出来了，外婆！太好啦！谢谢你！太精彩了！太精彩了！太精彩了！

words.ex: Peppa cannot find George anywhere. Daddy, I can't find George anywhere!
words.exZh: 佩奇到处都找不到乔治。爸爸，我哪儿都找不到乔治！

words.ex: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
words.exZh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

words.ex: Peppa has made a snowball. Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
words.exZh: 佩奇团了一个雪球。佩奇和乔治玩得非常开心。

words.ex: Peppa has made a snowball. Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
words.exZh: 佩奇团了一个雪球。佩奇和乔治玩得非常开心。

words.ex: Stop, Daddy! We promised the rest of the cake for the ducks.
words.exZh: 停下，爸爸！我们答应过把剩下的蛋糕给鸭子的。

words.ex: Hello, my little ones! Hello. Peppa, George, into your beds, quick!
words.exZh: 你们好，我的小宝贝们！你们好。佩奇，乔治，快上床去！

words.ex: George, I could see you too easily. Now it is Peppa's turn to hide.
words.exZh: 乔治，我太容易就看到你了。现在轮到佩奇躲起来了。

words.ex: And now the tennis racket, please! Thank you! Now watch this!
words.exZh: 现在请给我网球拍！谢谢！大家看好啦！

words.ex: Ooh, what is the present? It's got wheels! Car! It's not a car, George!
words.exZh: 哦，礼物是什么呢？它有轮子！汽车！乔治，那不是汽车！

words.ex: Luckily I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
words.exZh: 幸好我总算保住了我那块草莓蛋糕。

words.ex: All right, you old sea dog, race you! Prepare to lose, water hog!
words.exZh: 好吧，你这老水狗，跟你比一场！准备认输吧，水耗子！

words.ex: Now my secret box is full. George, you must not look inside.
words.exZh: 现在我的秘密盒子装满了。乔治，你不能往里面看。

words.ex: That does not sound right, either. Peppa was right. It is impossible to play.
words.exZh: 这个听起来也不对。佩奇说得对。这根本吹不响。

words.ex: Silly Peppa. What's your favorite game? Jumping in muddy puddles.
words.exZh: 傻佩奇。你最喜欢玩什么？跳泥坑。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Peppa, would you like your face painted? Yes, please. Can I be an elephant?
words.exZh: 佩奇，你想画脸吗？想。我能画成大象吗？

words.ex: Peppa, look, the puddles are back! Quick, George, let's get our boots!
words.exZh: 佩奇你看，泥坑又回来了！快点，乔治，我们去拿靴子！

words.ex: Oh, dear, Peppa, you don't look very well. Don't worry, I'll ring Dr. Brown Bear.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，佩奇，你看起来不太舒服。别担心，我给棕熊医生打电话。

words.ex: Children, it's time to decide who has the best fancy dress costume. We need a judge.
words.exZh: 孩子们，现在该选出谁的化装服最棒了。我们需要一位评委。

words.ex: No. George does not like tomatoes. Oh, dear. Do you both like lettuce? Yes, Grandpa Pig.
words.exZh: 不喜欢。乔治不喜欢西红柿。哦，天哪。你们俩喜欢生菜吗？喜欢，猪爷爷。

words.ex: It is morning. Daddy, it was lovely and cozy in the tent. Oh, where's Daddy?
words.exZh: 天亮了。爸爸，帐篷里又暖和又舒服。哦，爸爸去哪儿了？

words.ex: I see. Say the secret words. Daddy's big tummy! That's right, Daddy's big tummy!
words.exZh: 我明白了。说出暗号吧。爸爸的大肚子！没错，爸爸的大肚子！

words.ex: Lunchtime, everyone! Coming! After lunch, we'll do a puppet show. Hooray!
words.exZh: 开饭啦，大家！来啦！吃完午饭，我们就来演木偶戏。太好啦！

words.ex: This old boat can go faster than your rusty bucket any day, Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 猪爷爷，我这艘老船哪天都比你那艘锈桶跑得快！

words.ex: Daddy Pig has made his own bubble mixture! Come on, everyone!
words.exZh: 猪爸爸自己做了一盆泡泡水！大家快来！

words.ex: Horsey Twinkle Toes. Peppa and George are playing in their bedroom.
words.exZh: 小马闪亮脚趾。佩奇和乔治在他们的卧室里玩。

words.ex: A dinosaur? Oh, yes, it wasn't a dragon, it was a dinosaur, living outside.
words.exZh: 是恐龙吗？哦，对，那不是龙，是一只恐龙，就住在城堡外面。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Lunchtime, everyone! Coming! After lunch, we'll do a puppet show. Hooray!
words.exZh: 开饭啦，大家！来啦！吃完午饭，我们就来演木偶戏。太好啦！

words.ex: George looks on top of the television, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
words.exZh: 乔治在电视机上面找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: It is bath time. Peppa wants to keep her new shoes on, even for her bath.
words.exZh: 洗澡时间到了。佩奇想穿着她的新鞋，连洗澡也不脱。

words.ex: I'm not as little as George. I can drink juice as quickly as I want to.
words.exZh: 我可不像乔治那么小。我想喝多快就喝多快。

words.ex: George is trying really hard, but he is running out of breath!
words.exZh: 乔治非常努力地试了，可他的气不够用了！

words.ex: Maybe it isn't a good idea to play with dinosaurs near trees.
words.exZh: 也许在树附近玩恐龙不是个好主意。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: George, you've done it all wrong. I know a better way to cure hiccups.
words.exZh: 乔治，你全做错了。我知道一个更好的治打嗝办法。

words.ex: Hmm, frogs are not as pretty as butterflies or as wiggly as worms.
words.exZh: 嗯，青蛙没有蝴蝶漂亮，也没有蠕虫会扭。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Peppa looks under the newspaper, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
words.exZh: 佩奇在报纸下面找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you're holding the map upside down! Yes, I thought as much.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你把地图拿反了！是的，我也觉得是。

words.ex: George, today I'm going to teach you how to paint a flower.
words.exZh: 乔治，今天我要教你画一朵花。

words.ex: No, George. Only I must know what's in the box. You have to wait outside while I choose.
words.exZh: 不行，乔治。只有我能知道盒子里有什么。我挑选的时候你得在外面等着。

words.ex: Without his glasses on, Daddy Pig cannot read his newspaper.
words.exZh: 不戴眼镜，猪爸爸就没法看报纸。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Onions! I remember now! Here they are! Well done! One, two, three, four onions!
words.exZh: 洋葱！我现在想起来了！在这儿呢！干得好！一、二、三、四个洋葱！

words.ex: That's very kind of you, Daddy Pig. Now, be careful, it's a very deep hole.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你真是太好了。现在小心点，这个洞很深。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, Peppa, and George are decorating the sitting room.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸、佩奇和乔治在装饰客厅。

words.ex: I want to eat, then have a nap. I certainly don't want to run around.
words.exZh: 我想吃东西，然后睡个午觉。我可不想跑来跑去。

words.ex: Good. Anyway, now the pumpkin is broken, I can make it into pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 很好。反正南瓜已经坏了，我可以把它做成南瓜派。

words.ex: Danny, Suzy, Rebecca, look. I don't need my stabilizers anymore. Look at me!
words.exZh: 丹尼、苏西、瑞贝卡，快看。我不再需要辅助轮了。看着我！

words.ex: You're doing really well, Peppa. Hold on, Daddy. Just keep pedaling.
words.exZh: 你做得非常好，佩奇。抓紧，爸爸。继续踩踏板。

words.ex: Never mind the pumpkin. The important thing is that you are okay.
words.exZh: 南瓜没关系。重要的是你没事。

words.ex: Silly magic Daddy, you said all three colours! Shush, Peppa, don't tell anyone!
words.exZh: 傻乎乎的魔术师爸爸，你把三个颜色全说了一遍！嘘，佩奇，别告诉别人！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Peppa has found Mummy's makeup box. Aha! First, some powder. Lovely!
words.exZh: 佩奇找到了妈妈的化妆盒。啊哈！先扑点粉。真好看！

words.ex: Welcome aboard, me hearties! Peppa, George, let's put your life jackets on.
words.exZh: 欢迎登船，我的小水手们！佩奇，乔治，来把救生衣穿上。

words.ex: What a lovely surprise. Blow the candles out and make a wish.
words.exZh: 多么美好的惊喜。吹蜡烛许个愿吧。

words.ex: Good, that's enough sticks. That's a splendid campfire. Now I'll light it.
words.exZh: 好了，树枝够了。这堆篝火真棒。现在我来把它点着。

words.ex: Oh, dear, Peppa, you don't look very well. Don't worry, I'll ring Dr. Brown Bear.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，佩奇，你看起来不太舒服。别担心，我给棕熊医生打电话。

words.ex: Daddy Pig's hat and scarf and gloves are on the snowman!
words.exZh: 猪爸爸的帽子、围巾和手套都在雪人身上！

words.ex: Chloe paints the puppet's eyes. Can I do the mouth? Okay.
words.exZh: 克洛伊给木偶画眼睛。我能画嘴巴吗？好呀。

words.ex: Oh, I just remembered, I think the torch is in the kitchen!
words.exZh: 哦，我想起来了，手电筒好像在厨房里！

words.ex: It's only mud. Let's clean up quickly before Mummy sees the mess.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。我们赶紧清理干净，别让妈妈看到这团乱。

words.ex: And my little brother George is a scary dinosaur! Grr!
words.exZh: 还有我的弟弟乔治是一只吓人的恐龙！吼！

words.ex: A detective is a very important person who is good at finding things.
words.exZh: 侦探是很重要的人，擅长找东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: A detective is a very important person who is good at finding things.
words.exZh: 侦探是很重要的人，擅长找东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: George, I'm going to throw the ball, and then you have to catch it.
words.exZh: 乔治，我要把球扔出去，然后你要接住它。

words.ex: Dressing Up. Peppa and George are playing in Mummy and Daddy's bedroom.
words.exZh: 装扮游戏。佩奇和乔治在猪爸爸和猪妈妈的卧室里玩。

words.ex: Now they make the snowman's head. Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
words.exZh: 现在他们做雪人的头。现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

words.ex: I'm Nurse Susie, I make people better. Very good, Nurse Susie!
words.exZh: 我是护士苏西，我能让病人好起来。非常好，护士苏西！

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. George has found somewhere to hide.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八。乔治找到了躲藏的地方。

words.ex: I'll be fine, I can see very well in the dark!
words.exZh: 我没事的，我在黑暗里看得可清楚了！

words.ex: George, today I'm going to teach you how to paint a flower.
words.exZh: 乔治，今天我要教你画一朵花。

words.ex: George, I'm not going to sleep. Let's both stay awake all night and see the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 乔治，我不睡觉了。我们两个整晚都别睡，看看牙仙长什么样。

words.ex: First, I put some flour in the bowl. Ooh! Now I add an egg. Now the milk, and I give it all a stir.
words.exZh: 首先，我在碗里放些面粉。哦！现在加一个鸡蛋。现在加牛奶，然后全部搅一搅。

words.ex: Oh, yes. This tiny apple seed will grow into a little apple tree, like this.
words.exZh: 哦，是的。这颗小小的苹果籽会长成一棵小苹果树，就像这样。

words.ex: Peppa is going to choose some secret things to put in the box.
words.exZh: 佩奇要挑几样秘密的东西放进盒子里。

words.ex: That's funny! What are you, Rebecca Rabbit? I'm a carrot!
words.exZh: 真有趣！瑞贝卡，你扮的是什么？我是一根胡萝卜！

words.ex: I'm not as little as George. I can drink juice as quickly as I want to.
words.exZh: 我可不像乔治那么小。我想喝多快就喝多快。

words.ex: The sky is getting darker and darker. There is going to be a thunderstorm.
words.exZh: 天变得越来越暗了。要下雷阵雨了。

words.ex: Mummy, can we feed the ducks? Yes, you can feed them the rest of the bread.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我们可以喂鸭子吗？可以，你们可以把剩下的面包喂给它们。

words.ex: Look, Grandpa. There's a little frog. Why don't you play at being frogs?
words.exZh: 爷爷，看。有一只小青蛙。你们为什么不扮青蛙呢？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: The new car has squirted Daddy Pig with water. Silly Daddy. That's not the roof.
words.exZh: 新车朝猪爸爸喷了水。傻爸爸。那不是车篷按钮。

words.ex: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

words.ex: Chloé's here! Auntie Pig has brought Chloé to spend the day at Peppa's house.
words.exZh: 克洛伊来啦！猪阿姨把克洛伊带来，在佩奇家玩一天。

words.ex: One penny and two buttons! Here's your change, one button! Thank you, Mr. Fox!
words.exZh: 一枚便士和两颗纽扣！这是找你的钱，一颗纽扣！谢谢你，狐狸先生！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: Pancakes. It is teatime, and Mummy Pig has a surprise for everyone.
words.exZh: 薄煎饼。下午茶时间到了，猪妈妈给大家准备了一个惊喜。

words.ex: Mummy, if I was the queen, I would eat as much cake as I wanted. Peppa imagines being a queen.
words.exZh: 妈妈，如果我是王后，我想吃多少蛋糕就吃多少。佩奇在想象自己当王后的样子。

words.ex: The sun is very hot, so Peppa and George have to have sun cream on.
words.exZh: 太阳很晒，所以佩奇和乔治必须涂上防晒霜。

words.ex: The main thing is... aye... I won the race, Grandpa Pig! Naughty Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 重要的是……哎呀……我赢了比赛，猪爷爷！调皮的猪爷爷！

words.ex: A dinosaur! George loves dinosaurs! George is eating the tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber!
words.exZh: 恐龙！乔治最喜欢恐龙了！乔治正在吃西红柿、生菜和黄瓜呢！

words.ex: Everyone loves the slide! Mummy, Daddy, look at me! Ready, steady, go!
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢滑梯！妈妈，爸爸，看我的！各就各位，预备，开始！

words.ex: Daddy, I love being at the beach! Peppa and George love the beach. Everyone loves the beach!
words.exZh: 爸爸，我喜欢待在海边！佩奇和乔治喜欢海边。大家都喜欢海边！

words.ex: It's only mud. Let's clean up quickly before Mummy sees the mess.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。我们赶紧清理干净，别让妈妈看到这团乱。

words.ex: All right, ready, steady, go. Don't let go, Daddy. Don't worry, I've got you.
words.exZh: 好了，各就各位，预备，开始。爸爸，别松手。别担心，我扶着你呢。

words.ex: Look, Grandpa. There's a little frog. Why don't you play at being frogs?
words.exZh: 爷爷，看。有一只小青蛙。你们为什么不扮青蛙呢？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: George likes helping Mummy make cookies, but he likes playing with Peppa more.
words.exZh: 乔治喜欢帮妈妈做饼干，但他更喜欢和佩奇一起玩。

words.ex: That really does not sound right. Maybe it just needs someone big and strong like me.
words.exZh: 这个听起来真的不对。也许需要像我这样又大又壮的人来吹。

words.ex: George likes helping Mummy make cookies, but he likes playing with Peppa more.
words.exZh: 乔治喜欢帮妈妈做饼干，但他更喜欢和佩奇一起玩。

words.ex: Peppa has red spots on her face. Not me! I don't feel very well.
words.exZh: 佩奇脸上有红色的斑点。不是我！我觉得不太舒服。

words.ex: One, two. Here I come. Mummy Pig has finished her birthday breakfast.
words.exZh: 一、二。我来了。猪妈妈吃完她的生日早餐了。

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five. That's five! The thunderstorm is going away.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五。数到五！雷阵雨正在离我们远去。

words.ex: George looks in Daddy's slippers, but the glasses are not there either.
words.exZh: 乔治在爸爸的拖鞋里找，眼镜也不在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Ah, stand back, children. Please be careful, Daddy Pig. I know what I'm doing.
words.exZh: 啊，孩子们，退后一点。猪爸爸，请小心。我知道我在做什么。

words.ex: Hello, Peppa. Hello, George. I want to show you something. Wait for us!
words.exZh: 你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。我要给你们看样东西。等等我们！

words.ex: Don't worry, Peppa. Next time you come, the seed will have grown into a plant.
words.exZh: 别担心，佩奇。下次你们来的时候，种子就长成植株了。

words.ex: One, two. Here I come. Mummy Pig has finished her birthday breakfast.
words.exZh: 一、二。我来了。猪妈妈吃完她的生日早餐了。

words.ex: Now they make the snowman's head. Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
words.exZh: 现在他们做雪人的头。现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

words.ex: Never mind, Daddy Pig, just stick to the accordion. You play it beautifully.
words.exZh: 没关系，猪爸爸，你还是拉手风琴吧。你拉得非常动听。

words.ex: Oh, I can do it! Look at me. Look at me. I can ride my bike properly.
words.exZh: 哦，我会骑了！看着我。看着我。我能好好骑车了。

words.ex: It's time to go home. Say goodbye to the ducks. Bye bye, ducks! See you next time.
words.exZh: 该回家了。跟鸭子说再见吧。再见，鸭子们！下次见。

words.ex: George, when I was a little piggy, I used to like playing at being a worm.
words.exZh: 乔治，我小时候也喜欢玩扮蠕虫。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
words.exZh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

words.ex: Please, Mummy, please play it. I hope I haven't forgotten how.
words.exZh: 求你了，妈妈，拉一曲吧。希望我还没忘记怎么拉。

words.ex: Yes, I've got all those. Most important of all, we need a dinosaur balloon for George.
words.exZh: 好的，这些我都有。最重要的是，我们需要给乔治一个恐龙气球。

words.ex: I'm going to visit my grandma! I'm going to visit my grandma! Bravo, Peppa!
words.exZh: 我要去看望我的外婆！我要去看望我的外婆！太棒了，佩奇！

words.ex: George. The accordion is almost as difficult to play as my drum. Okay.
words.exZh: 乔治。手风琴几乎和我的鼓一样难。好吧。

words.ex: Look, look, I'm a butterfly. Yes, Peppa. You're a beautiful butterfly.
words.exZh: 看，看，我是一只蝴蝶。是的，佩奇。你是一只漂亮的蝴蝶。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Poor Teddy, he's soaking wet! Yes, poor Teddy. Let's get him dry.
words.exZh: 可怜的泰迪，他全身都湿透了！是啊，可怜的泰迪。我们把他弄干吧。

words.ex: Yes, the little piggies are asleep, and so are the big piggies!
words.exZh: 在呢，小猪们睡着了，大猪们也睡着啦！

words.ex: Oh, dear. I do not seem to have any dinosaur balloons. Oh.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。我好像没有恐龙气球。哦。

words.ex: Dinosaur. A dinosaur? Uh, how about a tiger instead? I'm good at tigers.
words.exZh: 恐龙。恐龙？呃，要不画老虎吧？我擅长画老虎。

words.ex: Grandpa Pig, can you call everyone to lunch? Lunch!
words.exZh: 猪爷爷，你能叫大家来吃午饭吗？开饭啦！

words.ex: What's that? It's a tooth. Where did that come from, Peppa? Maybe you should look in the mirror.
words.exZh: 那是什么？是一颗牙。佩奇，它是从哪儿来的？也许你该照照镜子。

words.ex: What little darlings. Now go to sleep quickly. Yes, Mummy. So well behaved.
words.exZh: 多可爱的小宝贝呀。现在快点睡觉吧。好的，妈妈。真听话。

words.ex: Oh, George! Oh, the noise is George. He was so tired, he has fallen asleep.
words.exZh: 哦，乔治！哦，原来是乔治的声音。他太累了，已经睡着了。

words.ex: Grandad Dog runs the garage. He is very good at mending cars.
words.exZh: 狗爷爷经营着修理厂。他非常擅长修车。

words.ex: What does the blue button do? I don't know. Let's see.
words.exZh: 蓝色按钮是做什么的？我不知道。我们来看看。

words.ex: Oh, the rain is coming in the house! The floor is getting wet. Oh, dear, what can we do?
words.exZh: 哦，雨水进到屋里来了！地板都湿了。哦，天哪，我们该怎么办？

words.ex: Suzy Sheep is Peppa's best friend. I'll ring Suzy Sheep's Mummy.
words.exZh: 小羊苏西是佩奇最好的朋友。我给苏西的妈妈打电话。

words.ex: Oh, but it's so boring. Dr. Brown Bear did say you could have visitors. Can Suzy visit me?
words.exZh: 哦，可是太无聊了。棕熊医生确实说了你可以有访客。那苏西能来看我吗？

words.ex: George. Now it's Chloé's turn to be the sly fox.
words.exZh: 乔治。现在轮到克洛伊当狡猾的狐狸了。

words.ex: Mummy Pig, Peppa and George are sleeping in the tent. Daddy Pig is sleeping outside under the stars.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈、佩奇和乔治睡在帐篷里。猪爸爸睡在外面，头顶是满天星星。

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five. That's five! The thunderstorm is going away.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五。数到五！雷阵雨正在离我们远去。

words.ex: This old boat can go faster than your rusty bucket any day, Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 猪爷爷，我这艘老船哪天都比你那艘锈桶跑得快！

words.ex: Camping. Peppa and her family are going camping. I love camping!
words.exZh: 露营。佩奇一家要去露营。我喜欢露营！

words.ex: My Birthday Party. It is Peppa's birthday. It is very early in the morning.
words.exZh: 我的生日派对。今天是佩奇的生日。现在是一大清早。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Children, it's time to decide who has the best fancy dress costume. We need a judge.
words.exZh: 孩子们，现在该选出谁的化装服最棒了。我们需要一位评委。

words.ex: I'm sorry I called you a sea dog, Granddad. Say sorry to Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 对不起，我不该叫你老水狗，狗爷爷。跟猪爷爷道歉！

words.ex: Here are the tomatoes, Mummy! Well done, Peppa! One, two, three, four! Now put them in the trolley!
words.exZh: 妈妈，西红柿在这儿！干得好，佩奇！一、二、三、四个！现在把它们放进购物车里！

words.ex: Let's take all this fruit back to Granny Pig! Granny! Granny! Mummy had an adventure!
words.exZh: 我们把这些水果都带回去给猪奶奶吧！奶奶！奶奶！妈妈经历了一场冒险！

words.ex: George has seen some really big juicy blackberries! Careful, George, or you might get tangled!
words.exZh: 乔治发现了几颗又大又多汁的黑莓！乔治小心点，不然会被缠住的！

words.ex: Stop, George! I must check if it's safe for you.
words.exZh: 停下，乔治！我得先检查对你是否安全。

words.ex: It's only mud. Let's clean up quickly before Mummy sees the mess.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。我们赶紧清理干净，别让妈妈看到这团乱。

words.ex: Peppa cannot find George anywhere. Daddy, I can't find George anywhere!
words.exZh: 佩奇到处都找不到乔治。爸爸，我哪儿都找不到乔治！

words.ex: And inside this apple are more seeds, to make more apple trees.
words.exZh: 而这个苹果里面还有更多的籽，可以长出更多的苹果树。

words.ex: Oh dear, you're very, very hot. I think you have to stay in bed for three years!
words.exZh: 哎呀，你烧得非常非常烫。我觉得你得在床上躺三年！

words.ex: What a clever car. Wow. When you come back, I will have fixed your car.
words.exZh: 多聪明的车呀。哇。等你们回来，我就把你们的车修好了。

words.ex: Granny, please can we leave the table and go and see Polly Parrot?
words.exZh: 奶奶，我们可以离开餐桌去看波莉鹦鹉吗？

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five. That's five! The thunderstorm is going away.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五。数到五！雷阵雨正在离我们远去。

words.ex: George should have another turn, but George isn't very good at hiding.
words.exZh: 乔治应该再玩一次，但乔治不太会躲。

words.ex: The Tooth Fairy will take the tooth, and in its place she will leave a shiny coin.
words.exZh: 牙仙会把牙齿带走，然后在原来的地方留下一枚亮闪闪的硬币。

words.ex: Peppa and George are going to the playgroup. It's George's first day.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治要去幼儿园。这是乔治第一天去。

words.ex: Thank you, Grandad Dog. Goodbye. Goodbye. Bye-bye. Goodbye.
words.exZh: 谢谢你，狗爷爷。再见。再见。拜拜。再见。

words.ex: It is home time, and the children's parents are here to pick them up.
words.exZh: 放学时间到了，孩子们的父母来接他们了。

words.ex: Mummy, can George and I sit on your lap and watch you work?
words.exZh: 妈妈，我和乔治可以坐在你腿上看你工作吗？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: Wow! Yes, I am a bit of an expert at these things.
words.exZh: 哇！是的，我对这些事情还算在行。

words.ex: Uh, Peppa, George, forget what I just said about Uncle Pig. Okay, Daddy.
words.exZh: 呃，佩奇，乔治，忘了我刚才说的关于猪叔叔的话。好的，爸爸。

words.ex: Let's play on the slide! Yes, the slide! Yippee! Peppa loves the slide!
words.exZh: 我们去玩滑梯吧！好耶，滑梯！太好啦！佩奇喜欢滑梯！

words.ex: Peppa wanted to copy George, but she's too big and has got stuck.
words.exZh: 佩奇想学乔治的样子，可是她太大了，卡住了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Mummy, I think they want some more. That was the last of the bread.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我觉得它们还想吃。面包已经没有了。

words.ex: Wow, it's so tall. Let's go inside. The view from the top is fantastic.
words.exZh: 哇，它好高啊。我们进去吧。从顶上看出去的风景美极了。

words.ex: Peppa and George must stay very still. Peppa, I saw you move. Back to the start!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治必须一动不动。佩奇，我看见你动了。退回起点！

words.ex: And inside this apple are more seeds, to make more apple trees.
words.exZh: 而这个苹果里面还有更多的籽，可以长出更多的苹果树。

words.ex: It is a lovely sunny day, and Peppa and George are riding their bicycles.
words.exZh: 今天阳光明媚，佩奇和乔治在骑他们的自行车。

words.ex: George, let's dress up and pretend to be Mummy and Daddy.
words.exZh: 乔治，我们来打扮一下，假装是妈妈和爸爸吧。

words.ex: Disgusting! You are a brave little one for taking it so well.
words.exZh: 太难吃了！你真是个勇敢的小家伙，这么乖就把药吃了。

words.ex: On the count of three, we all have to start jumping up and down. One, two, three, jump!
words.exZh: 数到三的时候，我们大家一起用力往上跳。一、二、三，跳！

words.ex: Peppa, maybe you would do better with this tin drum. Thank you, Daddy.
words.exZh: 佩奇，也许你用这个铁皮鼓会好一些。谢谢你，爸爸。

words.ex: Me! Higher! Maybe Grandpa Pig is a bit tired.
words.exZh: 我！再高一点！也许猪爷爷有点累了。

words.ex: Thunderstorm. It is a lovely sunny day. Peppa and George are having a picnic.
words.exZh: 雷阵雨。今天天气晴朗，阳光明媚。佩奇和乔治在野餐。

words.ex: Mummy, I think they want some more. That was the last of the bread.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我觉得它们还想吃。面包已经没有了。

words.ex: Peppa and George love their car. Is everybody ready? Ready. Then let's go.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治很喜欢他们的车。大家都准备好了吗？准备好了。那我们出发吧。

words.ex: The Tooth Fairy. Peppa and George are having their favorite food: spaghetti.
words.exZh: 牙仙。佩奇和乔治在吃他们最喜欢的食物：意大利面。

words.ex: I hope the wasp doesn't sting Daddy. Oh, get away, you little pest!
words.exZh: 希望黄蜂别蜇到爸爸。哦，走开，你这个小讨厌鬼！

words.ex: I hope the wasp doesn't sting Daddy. Oh, get away, you little pest!
words.exZh: 希望黄蜂别蜇到爸爸。哦，走开，你这个小讨厌鬼！

words.ex: Mummy, can I play the violin? Hold it like this. Yes, Mummy.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我可以拉小提琴吗？要像这样拿。好的，妈妈。

words.ex: Oh, dear. There aren't any dinosaurs at the fete, George.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。乔治，游园会上没有恐龙。

words.ex: Candy Cat and Pedro Pony are on the climbing frame. Hello! Meow!
words.exZh: 小猫坎迪和小马佩德罗在攀爬架上。你们好！喵！

words.ex: Candy Cat and Pedro Pony are on the climbing frame. Hello! Meow!
words.exZh: 小猫坎迪和小马佩德罗在攀爬架上。你们好！喵！

words.ex: What a lovely surprise. Blow the candles out and make a wish.
words.exZh: 多么美好的惊喜。吹蜡烛许个愿吧。

words.ex: Okay. A scary dinosaur puppet. Chloe is making George a dinosaur puppet. It needs pointy teeth. They're a scary dinosaur.
words.exZh: 好吧。那就做一个吓人的恐龙木偶。克洛伊在给乔治做恐龙木偶。它需要尖尖的牙齿。这才是吓人的恐龙。

words.ex: Next time I will stay awake, and I will see the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 下次我一定不睡，我要亲眼看看牙仙。

words.ex: Today, Peppa and her family are going for a drive in their red car. Shall we have the roof down? Yes, please.
words.exZh: 今天，佩奇一家要开他们的红色汽车去兜风。我们把车篷打开好吗？好呀。

words.ex: Very good. My, my, who have we here? I'm a pirate! Shiver me timbers!
words.exZh: 非常好。哎呀，我们这儿还有谁呀？我是海盗！嘿哟嘿哟！

words.ex: Children, it's time to decide who has the best fancy dress costume. We need a judge.
words.exZh: 孩子们，现在该选出谁的化装服最棒了。我们需要一位评委。

words.ex: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

words.ex: Yes, but it's very cold outside, so you must wrap up warm.
words.exZh: 可以，不过外面很冷，你们得穿暖和些。

words.ex: Daddy Pig looks quite cold. He isn't wearing his hat and scarf and gloves.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸看起来挺冷的。他没戴帽子、围巾和手套。

words.ex: Do you play it with the proper rules or the baby rules? Proper rules.
words.exZh: 你们是按正式规则玩，还是按小孩子规则玩？正式规则。

words.ex: Chloé! George, Chloé is a big girl like me.
words.exZh: 克洛伊！乔治，克洛伊是像我一样的大孩子。

words.ex: Mummy Pig is going to flip the pancake over.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈要把煎饼翻个面。

words.ex: Thank you for that story, King Daddy. You're welcome, Queen Mummy. And our little prince and princess enjoyed it, too.
words.exZh: 谢谢你讲的故事，国王爸爸。不客气，王后妈妈。我们的小王子和公主也很喜欢。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Poor Teddy, he's soaking wet! Yes, poor Teddy. Let's get him dry.
words.exZh: 可怜的泰迪，他全身都湿透了！是啊，可怜的泰迪。我们把他弄干吧。

words.ex: Look, Peppa, this is the queen's golden crown.
words.exZh: 佩奇你看，这是王后的金王冠。

words.ex: It's not funny! It looks very funny, Daddy! I suppose it is a bit funny. We'll have to push you down!
words.exZh: 这一点都不好笑！爸爸，看起来特别好笑！我想确实有点好笑。我们得把你推下去！

words.zh: 猪（剧中 water hog 是玩笑称呼）
words.ex: All right, you old sea dog, race you! Prepare to lose, water hog!
words.exZh: 好吧，你这老水狗，跟你比一场！准备认输吧，水耗子！

words.ex: Shopping. Peppa and George are going shopping. Peppa and George like shopping.
words.exZh: 购物。佩奇和乔治要去购物。佩奇和乔治喜欢购物。

words.zh: 阿布拉卡达布拉（魔术咒语）
words.ex: Ho, ho! For my first trick... abracadabra!
words.exZh: 呵呵！我的第一个魔术……阿布拉卡达布拉！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Peppa quite enjoyed the powercut, but she's happy the electricity is back again!
words.exZh: 佩奇还挺喜欢这次停电的，不过电回来了她也很开心！

words.ex: Come along, Daddy Pig. It's time to go to work.
words.exZh: 走吧，猪爸爸。该去上班了。

words.ex: Here they are! Grr! Dinosaur! Ah! It's a dinosaur! Help! Help!
words.exZh: 它们在这儿呢！吼！恐龙！啊！是恐龙！救命！救命！

words.ex: Oh, come on, George, let's get some air into this paddling pool!
words.exZh: 哦，快点，乔治，我们给戏水池充点气吧！

words.ex: I wonder if this time you threw Mr. Dinosaur just a bit too high.
words.exZh: 我在想，这次你是不是把他抛得太高了一点。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Suzy Sheep is Peppa's best friend. I'll ring Suzy Sheep's Mummy.
words.exZh: 小羊苏西是佩奇最好的朋友。我给苏西的妈妈打电话。

words.ex: Oh, yes. This tiny apple seed will grow into a little apple tree, like this.
words.exZh: 哦，是的。这颗小小的苹果籽会长成一棵小苹果树，就像这样。

words.ex: Pancakes. It is teatime, and Mummy Pig has a surprise for everyone.
words.exZh: 薄煎饼。下午茶时间到了，猪妈妈给大家准备了一个惊喜。

words.ex: Granny, please can we leave the table and go and see Polly Parrot?
words.exZh: 奶奶，我们可以离开餐桌去看波莉鹦鹉吗？

words.ex: But George always hides under the table. Have you thought of looking upstairs?
words.exZh: 可是乔治总是躲在桌子下面。你有没有想过上楼去看看？

words.ex: I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
words.exZh: 我肯定他这次会好一点。闭上眼睛开始数数吧。

words.ex: Peppa looks under the newspaper, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
words.exZh: 佩奇在报纸下面找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Peppa, would you like your face painted? Yes, please. Can I be an elephant?
words.exZh: 佩奇，你想画脸吗？想。我能画成大象吗？

words.ex: I'm sure they've had enough. Sorry, Mrs. Duck, we've no more bread.
words.exZh: 我相信它们已经吃饱了。对不起，鸭太太，我们没有面包了。

words.ex: Peppa, you mustn't play so roughly with George. He's only little.
words.exZh: 佩奇，你不能跟乔治玩得这么粗鲁。他还小呢。

words.ex: Good. You have to throw the ball to each other and I have to try and catch it. I'm the piggy in the middle.
words.exZh: 很好。你们要把球互相传给对方，而我要试着把球抢到。我就是中间的那只小猪。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Peppa wanted to copy George, but she's too big and has got stuck.
words.exZh: 佩奇想学乔治的样子，可是她太大了，卡住了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: I suppose I'll just have to learn to do without them. If I move slowly, I won't bump into things.
words.exZh: 我想我只能学着没有眼镜过日子了。如果我慢慢走，就不会撞到东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: That's very kind of you, Daddy Pig. Now, be careful, it's a very deep hole.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你真是太好了。现在小心点，这个洞很深。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you are much too heavy for that branch! Nonsense, I know exactly how heavy I am.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，那根树枝可承受不了你的重量！胡说，我清楚自己有多重。

words.ex: And one day, Grandpa Pig finds something very special.
words.exZh: 有一天，猪爷爷发现了一个特别的东西。

words.ex: Daddy Pig has gone. Poor Daddy Pig, he must have been cold and wet. And now where is he?
words.exZh: 猪爸爸不见了。可怜的猪爸爸，他一定又冷又湿。那他现在在哪儿呢？

words.ex: George, you've done it all wrong. I know a better way to cure hiccups.
words.exZh: 乔治，你全做错了。我知道一个更好的治打嗝办法。

words.ex: Here comes Daddy Pig with two beakers of juice.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸拿着两杯果汁过来了。

words.ex: Everyone loves the slide! Mummy, Daddy, look at me! Ready, steady, go!
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢滑梯！妈妈，爸爸，看我的！各就各位，预备，开始！

words.ex: Do you play it with the proper rules or the baby rules? Proper rules.
words.exZh: 你们是按正式规则玩，还是按小孩子规则玩？正式规则。

words.ex: George. The accordion is almost as difficult to play as my drum. Okay.
words.exZh: 乔治。手风琴几乎和我的鼓一样难。好吧。

words.ex: Mmm, delicious. I'm going to hide mine in my tummy. Me, too!
words.exZh: 嗯，真好吃。我要把我的藏进肚子里。我也要！

words.ex: Mmm, delicious. I'm going to hide mine in my tummy. Me, too!
words.exZh: 嗯，真好吃。我要把我的藏进肚子里。我也要！

words.ex: The wind is quite strong now. The wind is very strong now.
words.exZh: 现在风挺大的。现在风非常大。

words.ex: Maybe that's enough washing. Granny Pig has made the tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber into a salad.
words.exZh: 洗得差不多啦。猪奶奶把西红柿、生菜和黄瓜做成了一份沙拉。

words.ex: Oh, do these pegs do anything? Of course, I forgot about the pegs. The pegs hold the tent up.
words.exZh: 哦，这些地钉有什么用吗？当然有用，我把地钉给忘了。地钉能把帐篷固定住。

words.ex: Musical Instruments. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have been tidying the house.
words.exZh: 乐器。猪妈妈和猪爸爸在收拾屋子。

words.ex: George. The accordion is almost as difficult to play as my drum. Okay.
words.exZh: 乔治。手风琴几乎和我的鼓一样难。好吧。

words.ex: Hmm, frogs are not as pretty as butterflies or as wiggly as worms.
words.exZh: 嗯，青蛙没有蝴蝶漂亮，也没有蠕虫会扭。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: I hope you are not digging in your best clothes, Daddy Pig.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，希望你不是穿着最好的衣服在挖土。

words.ex: Poor Peppa. Your shoes were getting a bit old. We'll buy you a new pair. Can my new shoes be red, Mummy? Of course they can.
words.exZh: 可怜的佩奇。你的鞋子有点旧了。我们给你买双新的吧。妈妈，我的新鞋可以是红色的吗？当然可以。

words.ex: Mr. Fox's Shop. Mummy and Daddy Pig are wrapping up a present.
words.exZh: 狐狸先生的商店。猪妈妈和猪爸爸正在包装一件礼物。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: The School Fete. Today is the day of the school fete.
words.exZh: 学校游园会。今天是学校游园会的日子。

words.ex: Candy Cat and Pedro Pony are on the climbing frame. Hello! Meow!
words.exZh: 小猫坎迪和小马佩德罗在攀爬架上。你们好！喵！

words.ex: I like the balloons. I like the bouncy castle the best.
words.exZh: 我喜欢气球。我最喜欢充气城堡。

words.ex: Can I have an elephant balloon, please? Here you are, Peppa.
words.exZh: 我可以要一个大象气球吗？给你，佩奇。

words.ex: What happened? Huh? Has the puppet show started yet?
words.exZh: 发生什么事了？啊？木偶戏开始了吗？

words.ex: Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig have arrived for Mummy Pig's birthday.
words.exZh: 猪奶奶和猪爷爷来给猪妈妈过生日了。

words.ex: What was that big splash? What big splash? Ah, Daddy Pig, did you know you've got a duck on your head? Oh, uh, yes, well, I did fall in the pond!
words.exZh: 刚才那声大水花是怎么回事？什么大水花？啊，猪爸爸，你知道你头上有一只鸭子吗？哦，呃，是的，嗯，我确实掉进池塘里了！

words.ex: Peppa! George! Wake up! It's morning!
words.exZh: 佩奇！乔治！醒醒！天亮啦！

words.ex: Hooray! You fell asleep, didn't you? Well, maybe I fell asleep just for a little bit.
words.exZh: 太好啦！你睡着了吧？嗯，也许我就睡了一小会儿。

words.ex: The first clue is in a bottle. But where is the bottle? I can see it.
words.exZh: 第一条线索在一个瓶子里。可瓶子在哪儿呢？我看见它了。

words.ex: Everyone loves chocolate coins. Granny, Grandpa, this is the best treasure hunt ever!
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢巧克力币。奶奶，爷爷，这是最棒的一次寻宝游戏！

words.ex: Daddy, will you ask my Mummy if I could have some ice cream? And Rebecca, could you bring me some flowers from the garden?
words.exZh: 爸爸，你能不能问问妈妈，我能不能吃点冰淇淋？瑞贝卡，你能从花园里给我采些花吗？

words.ex: Wow! These are the bones of a real dinosaur!
words.exZh: 哇！这些是真正的恐龙骨头！

words.ex: Now they make the snowman's head. Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
words.exZh: 现在他们做雪人的头。现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

words.ex: Peppa, George, today your big Cousin Chloé is coming to visit.
words.exZh: 佩奇，乔治，今天你们的表姐克洛伊要来做客。

words.ex: Mummy, now you've made the car all muddy again! Naughty Mummy! Naughty, messy Mummy!
words.exZh: 妈妈，现在你把车又弄得到处是泥了！调皮的妈妈！脏乱的调皮妈妈！

words.ex: George, you're making the car all muddy again! I will wash the mud off. Peppa, don't use the muddy water!
words.exZh: 乔治，你把车又弄得到处是泥了！我把泥冲掉。佩奇，别用那盆泥水！

words.ex: This is Grandpa Pig's vegetable garden. He has grown all these vegetables himself. What's this?
words.exZh: 这是猪爷爷的菜园。这些蔬菜都是他亲手种的。这是什么？

words.ex: Meow! Please, please, for the sake of the actors, no photography, please!
words.exZh: 喵！拜托，拜托，为了演员们着想，请不要拍照！

words.ex: Oh, come on, George, let's get some air into this paddling pool!
words.exZh: 哦，快点，乔治，我们给戏水池充点气吧！

words.ex: Oh, come on, George, let's get some air into this paddling pool!
words.exZh: 哦，快点，乔治，我们给戏水池充点气吧！

words.ex: George, you should eat your ice lolly before it melts. Thank you! George loves his dinosaur ice lolly so much, he doesn't want to eat it.
words.exZh: 乔治，你该趁冰棍还没化把它吃了。谢谢！乔治太喜欢他的恐龙冰棍了，都舍不得吃。

words.ex: Good idea! Let's see who can tidy up first. Ready, steady, go!
words.exZh: 好主意！看谁先收拾完。各就各位，预备，开始！

words.ex: Candy Cat and Pedro Pony are on the climbing frame. Hello! Meow!
words.exZh: 小猫坎迪和小马佩德罗在攀爬架上。你们好！喵！

words.ex: Peppa, George, would you like to play with your buckets and spades? Yes, please, Mummy!
words.exZh: 佩奇，乔治，你们想玩小桶和铲子吗？想，妈妈！

words.ex: Onions! I remember now! Here they are! Well done! One, two, three, four onions!
words.exZh: 洋葱！我现在想起来了！在这儿呢！干得好！一、二、三、四个洋葱！

words.ex: Perhaps you should play with the toy horse outside! Yes, Mummy!
words.exZh: 也许你们该到外面去玩这匹玩具马！好的，妈妈！

words.ex: Mummy Pig loves apple and blackberry crumble! Everyone loves apple and blackberry crumble!
words.exZh: 猪妈妈喜欢苹果黑莓酥！大家都喜欢苹果黑莓酥！

words.ex: The big bad wolf is pretending to be Grandma! I am Little Red Riding Hood! I'm going to visit my grandma! Bravo, Peppa!
words.exZh: 大灰狼在假扮外婆！我是小红帽！我要去看望我的外婆！太棒了，佩奇！

words.ex: Pedro Pony is going to play the hunter. He will rescue Peppa from the big bad wolf! Um... I'm the hunter! And Pedro is a bit shy!
words.exZh: 小马佩德罗要演猎人。他要把佩奇从大灰狼手里救出来！嗯……我是猎人！而且佩德罗有点害羞！

words.ex: It is raining today, so Peppa and George cannot play outside.
words.exZh: 今天在下雨，所以佩奇和乔治不能出去玩。

words.ex: Daddy, it's stopped raining. Can we go out to play?
words.exZh: 爸爸，雨停了。我们可以出去玩吗？

words.ex: What strange noises. I wonder if we should check upstairs.
words.exZh: 什么奇怪的声音。我们要不要上楼去看看。

words.ex: George's favourite toy is Mr. Dinosaur.
words.exZh: 乔治最喜欢的玩具是恐龙先生。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Peppa holds the hose, and Daddy Pig turns on the water. Where's the water?
words.exZh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪爸爸打开水龙头。水在哪儿呢？

words.ex: Fantastic! Come in, there's a fairy princess and a dinosaur waiting to meet you.
words.exZh: 太棒了！进来吧，有一位仙女公主和一只恐龙正等着见你们呢。

words.ex: Hello, Grandpa Pig. We can see you from Windy Castle. Wave at us!
words.exZh: 喂，猪爷爷。我们从风车城堡能看到你们。朝我们挥挥手吧！

words.ex: Open wide, please. Susie takes George's temperature.
words.exZh: 请把嘴张大。苏西给乔治量体温。

words.ex: Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game. George is our patient. Oh, I see.
words.exZh: 别担心，爸爸。这只是个游戏。乔治是我们的病人。哦，我明白了。

words.ex: They're for George, and his medicine to make him feel better.
words.exZh: 这是给乔治的，还有能让他好起来的药。

words.ex: Certainly. I've got lots of different ones.
words.exZh: 当然。我这儿有很多不一样的。

words.ex: What noisy little ones you are.
words.exZh: 你们这两个小家伙可真吵。

words.ex: No more red spots, you're completely better! Aren't I still a bit ill?
words.exZh: 红斑点都没了，你完全好了！我还算有点病吧？

words.ex: Peppa is enjoying pretending to be Mummy Pig, but George is getting a bit bored.
words.exZh: 佩奇很喜欢假装成猪妈妈，可乔治有点无聊了。

words.ex: George and Grandpa Pig are having such fun being wiggly worms.
words.exZh: 乔治和猪爷爷扮蠕虫玩得可开心了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: What was that strange noise? Peppa, George, quick, come inside the house!
words.exZh: 那是什么奇怪的声音？佩奇，乔治，快，进屋来！

words.ex: George was hiding behind Daddy Pig's newspaper all the time.
words.exZh: 乔治一直躲在猪爸爸的报纸后面。

words.ex: Oh, what's this? Teddy! I've been looking for you! Quick, Peppa, put Teddy in your toy basket!
words.exZh: 哦，这是什么？泰迪！我一直在找你！快点，佩奇，把泰迪放进你的玩具筐里！

words.ex: Daddy, maybe George is too small to go to my playgroup!
words.exZh: 爸爸，也许乔治太小了，不能去我的幼儿园！

words.ex: What a lovely surprise. Blow the candles out and make a wish.
words.exZh: 多么美好的惊喜。吹蜡烛许个愿吧。

words.ex: George is my brother. He's brilliant.
words.exZh: 乔治是我的弟弟。他很棒。

words.ex: Mummy Pig is working on her computer. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George. I beg your pardon?
words.exZh: 猪妈妈正在电脑上工作。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。你说什么？

words.ex: Oh, dear. I do not think it is meant to sound like that.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。我觉得它不该是这样响的。

words.ex: Um, maybe if I just switch it off and then switch it on again.
words.exZh: 嗯，也许我只要把它关掉，然后再打开就行了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: I just make a little hole and put the seed in. Then I cover it with earth and water it.
words.exZh: 我先挖一个小坑，把种子放进去。然后盖上土，再浇水。

words.ex: You really shouldn't play with your food! Sorry, Daddy!
words.exZh: 你们真不该拿食物来玩！对不起，爸爸！

words.ex: Without his glasses on, Daddy Pig cannot read his newspaper.
words.exZh: 不戴眼镜，猪爸爸就没法看报纸。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: We've looked everywhere, but we can't find Daddy's glasses. Oh dear, now what can we do?
words.exZh: 我们到处都找过了，可就是找不到爸爸的眼镜。哦，天哪，现在我们该怎么办？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Look at George. He's going so slowly. George is still riding a baby bike.
words.exZh: 看看乔治。他骑得好慢。乔治还在骑小孩子骑的车。

words.ex: But we're waiting for my strawberry plant to grow. I wanted strawberries for tea.
words.exZh: 可是我们在等我的草莓长大呢。我还想吃点心的时候吃草莓。

words.ex: Wow, the telescope makes everything look bigger. I can see Granny and Grandpa. Look, George!
words.exZh: 哇，望远镜把所有东西都放大了。我能看到爷爷和奶奶。乔治你看！

words.ex: I'm not as little as George. I can drink juice as quickly as I want to.
words.exZh: 我可不像乔治那么小。我想喝多快就喝多快。

words.ex: Oh, dear. I do not seem to have any dinosaur balloons. Oh.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。我好像没有恐龙气球。哦。

words.ex: Yours is a baby bike, too, Peppa. You've still got stabilizers.
words.exZh: 佩奇，你的也是小孩子骑的车。你车上还有辅助轮呢。

words.ex: Let's ride up the hill again. Are you coming, Peppa?
words.exZh: 我们再骑上山去吧。你来吗，佩奇？

words.ex: Good. Anyway, now the pumpkin is broken, I can make it into pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 很好。反正南瓜已经坏了，我可以把它做成南瓜派。

words.ex: Hmm, George's blue shirt? Nope. Is it something in the car? No. Give up? Yes. The sky! The blue sky!
words.exZh: 嗯，是乔治的蓝衬衫吗？不是。是车里的东西吗？不是。放弃了吗？放弃了。是天空！蓝色的天空！

words.ex: Okay, but we must do it at the same time. That's a good idea. On the count of three, you each show what's in your boxes. Ready? Yes!
words.exZh: 好吧，但我们必须同时打开。这是个好主意。数到三，你们各自亮出盒子里的东西。准备好了吗？好了！

words.ex: Luckily I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
words.exZh: 幸好我总算保住了我那块草莓蛋糕。

words.ex: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
words.exZh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

words.ex: Oh, dear. Everyone is covered in mud.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。大家都弄得一身泥。

words.ex: There! Hooray! Daddy Pig has rescued the kite.
words.exZh: 好了！太好啦！猪爸爸把风筝救下来了。

words.ex: Mummy's strawberry? I was just teasing. Mummy's homemade strawberry cake is there, too.
words.exZh: 妈妈的草莓？我刚才是开玩笑的。妈妈自制的草莓蛋糕也在里面。

words.ex: Ah, it's great to be outdoors. We should run around a bit and get some exercise.
words.exZh: 啊，在户外真舒服。我们应该跑一跑，锻炼锻炼身体。

words.ex: But later I will get some exercise, even if no one else does.
words.exZh: 不过待会儿我会去锻炼的，就算别人都不去。

words.ex: I'm sure they've had enough. Sorry, Mrs. Duck, we've no more bread.
words.exZh: 我相信它们已经吃饱了。对不起，鸭太太，我们没有面包了。

words.ex: Mummy, we do have strawberry cake. Well, if there's any cake left over, you can give it to the ducks.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我们还有草莓蛋糕呢。好吧，如果蛋糕有剩，你们可以拿去喂鸭子。

words.ex: Hmm, frogs are not as pretty as butterflies or as wiggly as worms.
words.exZh: 嗯，青蛙没有蝴蝶漂亮，也没有蠕虫会扭。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Sorry, Daddy Pig, I'm nearly finished. There, all done. Come on, Daddy Pig, it's time you did some work.
words.exZh: 抱歉，猪爸爸，我快做完了。好了，全都做完了。走吧，猪爸爸，该你干活了。

words.ex: George is going to play in the wet grass.
words.exZh: 乔治要在湿漉漉的草地上玩。

words.ex: George is the winner! Can we play a different game? Yes, but as long as it's a grown-up game.
words.exZh: 乔治赢啦！我们能玩个别的游戏吗？可以，但得是大孩子的游戏。

words.ex: Mmm, yummy. Quick, we have to get everything else ready.
words.exZh: 嗯，真好吃。快点，我们得把别的东西都准备好。

words.ex: My tummy rumbling is one of the best sounds of nature. It means it's time to eat! I love tomato soup. So do I!
words.exZh: 我的肚子咕咕叫是大自然最美妙的声音之一。它意味着该吃饭啦！我喜欢番茄汤。我也是！

words.ex: The Tooth Fairy will take the tooth, and in its place she will leave a shiny coin.
words.exZh: 牙仙会把牙齿带走，然后在原来的地方留下一枚亮闪闪的硬币。

words.ex: What is that noise? Is it the Tooth Fairy? George, can you hear something?
words.exZh: 那是什么声音？是牙仙吗？乔治，你听到什么了吗？

words.ex: My Birthday Party. It is Peppa's birthday. It is very early in the morning.
words.exZh: 我的生日派对。今天是佩奇的生日。现在是一大清早。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: But now it stopped raining. Can we open the roof again? Oh, yes. Which button was it? The red one. Hooray.
words.exZh: 可是现在雨停了。我们能再把车篷打开吗？哦，可以呀。是哪个按钮来着？红色那个。太好啦。

words.ex: Everyone loves chocolate coins. Granny, Grandpa, this is the best treasure hunt ever!
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢巧克力币。奶奶，爷爷，这是最棒的一次寻宝游戏！

words.ex: The first clue is in a bottle. But where is the bottle? I can see it.
words.exZh: 第一条线索在一个瓶子里。可瓶子在哪儿呢？我看见它了。

words.ex: Oh, it's a message from a pirate. Mummy, can you read the pirate's message? Hmm, this pirate has very bad handwriting.
words.exZh: 哦，是海盗写的一封信。妈妈，你能读一下海盗的信吗？嗯，这个海盗的字写得真差。

words.ex: The pirate's handwriting is excellent! No, I can't make it out at all.
words.exZh: 海盗的字写得棒极了！不对，我根本看不出来。

words.ex: No more red spots, you're completely better! Aren't I still a bit ill?
words.exZh: 红斑点都没了，你完全好了！我还算有点病吧？

words.ex: Disgusting! You are a brave little one for taking it so well.
words.exZh: 太难吃了！你真是个勇敢的小家伙，这么乖就把药吃了。

words.ex: Oh, but it's so boring. Dr. Brown Bear did say you could have visitors. Can Suzy visit me?
words.exZh: 哦，可是太无聊了。棕熊医生确实说了你可以有访客。那苏西能来看我吗？

words.ex: Peppa seems to be quite enjoying herself. Thank you, Suzy.
words.exZh: 佩奇看起来挺享受的。谢谢你，苏西。

words.ex: Dr. Brown Bear is here to see if Peppa is better. Ah, good, the nurse is already here. How is the patient?
words.exZh: 棕熊医生来看看佩奇好些没有。啊，很好，护士已经在这儿了。病人怎么样了？

words.ex: Peppa and George love making footprints in the snow.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在雪地上踩脚印。

words.ex: One person is the sly fox, and the others creep up on them. Me! Me! I want to be the sly fox.
words.exZh: 一个人当狡猾的狐狸，其他人悄悄靠近他。我！我！我要当狡猾的狐狸。

words.ex: Daddy Pig is in the sitting room, reading his newspaper. Mummy Pig is reading her book.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸在客厅里看报纸。猪妈妈在看书。

words.ex: Look at the view. Mummy, is that Granny and Grandpa's house? Yes, it is. It's so far away.
words.exZh: 快看这风景。妈妈，那是爷爷奶奶家吗？是的。好远啊。

words.ex: Now you say who the winner is. Oh, yes. Um... and the winner is me!
words.exZh: 现在你来宣布谁是冠军。哦，对。嗯……冠军就是我！

words.ex: George is the winner! Can we play a different game? Yes, but as long as it's a grown-up game.
words.exZh: 乔治赢啦！我们能玩个别的游戏吗？可以，但得是大孩子的游戏。

words.ex: This is a particularly thorny rose. To prune it, start by lopping off the head, and then snip away the budding shoots.
words.exZh: 这是一种刺特别多的玫瑰。要修剪它，先把顶端的花头剪掉，然后把新长出来的嫩芽剪掉。

words.ex: Thank you for that story, King Daddy. You're welcome, Queen Mummy. And our little prince and princess enjoyed it, too.
words.exZh: 谢谢你讲的故事，国王爸爸。不客气，王后妈妈。我们的小王子和公主也很喜欢。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Of course! And he was very handsome, like me. Anyway, there was also a dragon.
words.exZh: 当然啦！而且他非常英俊，就像我一样。总之，那里还有一条龙。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Daddy, you must not take photos! Oops! Sorry, Peppa! Carry on!
words.exZh: 爸爸，你不能拍照！哎哟！对不起，佩奇！继续吧！

words.ex: I love thunderstorms! They make muddy puddles! Splish, splash, splash!
words.exZh: 我喜欢雷阵雨！它们能造出泥坑！噗嗤，啪嗒，啪嗒！

words.ex: Oh, never mind, we can use the garden hose to clean it off. Yes, yes! Can I hold the hose?
words.exZh: 哦，没关系，我们可以用花园的水管把它冲干净。太好了，太好了！我能拿着水管吗？

words.ex: Peppa holds the hose, and Daddy Pig turns on the water. Where's the water?
words.exZh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪爸爸打开水龙头。水在哪儿呢？

words.ex: Maybe that's enough washing. Granny Pig has made the tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber into a salad.
words.exZh: 洗得差不多啦。猪奶奶把西红柿、生菜和黄瓜做成了一份沙拉。

words.ex: Good, that's enough sticks. That's a splendid campfire. Now I'll light it.
words.exZh: 好了，树枝够了。这堆篝火真棒。现在我来把它点着。

words.ex: The Museum. Peppa and her family are going to the museum.
words.exZh: 博物馆。佩奇一家要去博物馆。

words.ex: Peppa wants to see the room full of things that belong to kings and queens from long ago. Wow! But George wants to see the real dinosaur.
words.exZh: 佩奇想去看那个装满很久以前国王和王后用品的房间。哇！可乔治想去看真正的恐龙。

words.ex: First, you have to change into your swimming costumes. Yes, Mummy!
words.exZh: 首先，你们得换上游泳衣。好的，妈妈！

words.ex: Hello, my name is Chloe, and I am Peppa.
words.exZh: 你好，我叫克洛伊，这位是佩奇。

words.ex: What happened? Huh? Has the puppet show started yet?
words.exZh: 发生什么事了？啊？木偶戏开始了吗？

words.ex: But Mummy, we're playing dollies and dinosaurs! You can play again when you've tidied up.
words.exZh: 可是妈妈，我们在玩娃娃和恐龙呢！收拾好你们就可以接着玩。

words.ex: Candy Cat and Pedro Pony are on the climbing frame. Hello! Meow!
words.exZh: 小猫坎迪和小马佩德罗在攀爬架上。你们好！喵！

words.ex: Let's try out this spotty ball. It seems to work.
words.exZh: 我们来试试这个圆点球。看起来挺好用。

words.ex: We've got baskets for the apples and buckets for the blackberries! First, the easy bit: picking apples! On the count of three, shake the tree! One, two...
words.exZh: 我们有装苹果的篮子和装黑莓的桶！首先是简单的部分：摘苹果！数到三，摇树！一、二……

words.ex: Daddy Pig is going to do a magic show. Peppa, remember what you have to say. Ladies and gentlemen, introducing the amazing Mysterio!
words.exZh: 猪爸爸要表演魔术了。佩奇，记住你该说的话。女士们先生们，有请神奇的大魔术师！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Daddy Pig is going to do a magic show. Peppa, remember what you have to say. Ladies and gentlemen, introducing the amazing Mysterio!
words.exZh: 猪爸爸要表演魔术了。佩奇，记住你该说的话。女士们先生们，有请神奇的大魔术师！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Oh, my prince! My princess! You were meant to stay in there for a hundred years! That was quite long enough! Thank you!
words.exZh: 哦，我的王子！我的公主！你本该在里面待上一百年的！那已经够久了！谢谢你！

words.ex: Let me think. Have you been watching television?
words.exZh: 让我想想。你们刚才在看电视吗？

words.ex: George's favourite game is throwing Mr. Dinosaur up in the air and catching him when he falls back down.
words.exZh: 乔治最喜欢的游戏是把恐龙先生抛到空中，等他掉下来时再接住。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.zh: 事情（what's the matter 怎么了）
words.ex: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
words.exZh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

words.ex: A detective is a very important person who is good at finding things.
words.exZh: 侦探是很重要的人，擅长找东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Maybe the detective should ask George some simple questions.
words.exZh: 也许侦探应该问乔治一些简单的问题。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Peppa and George must stay very still. Peppa, I saw you move. Back to the start!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治必须一动不动。佩奇，我看见你动了。退回起点！

words.ex: Peppa and George are in their bedroom playing with their toys. George, let's play dollies and dinosaurs!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治在他们的卧室里玩玩具。乔治，我们来玩娃娃和恐龙吧！

words.ex: I'm afraid it doesn't taste very nice. Open wide, please.
words.exZh: 恐怕这药不太好吃。请把嘴张大。

words.ex: Oh, George! Oh, the noise is George. He was so tired, he has fallen asleep.
words.exZh: 哦，乔治！哦，原来是乔治的声音。他太累了，已经睡着了。

words.ex: Let's eat. Good idea, Mummy Pig. I'm really hungry.
words.exZh: 我们开吃吧。好主意，猪妈妈。我真的饿了。

words.ex: The Tree House. Peppa and George are visiting Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig.
words.exZh: 树屋。佩奇和乔治去猪奶奶和猪爷爷家做客。

words.ex: Peppa, George, this is our pet parrot. She's called Polly.
words.exZh: 佩奇，乔治，这是我们的宠物鹦鹉。她叫波莉。

words.ex: Polly is such a sweet parrot. Yes, Granny.
words.exZh: 波莉真是一只可爱的鹦鹉。是的，奶奶。

words.ex: George is a little bit shy.
words.exZh: 乔治有点害羞。

words.ex: Peppa and George are really enjoying playing with Polly Parrot.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治玩波莉鹦鹉玩得非常开心。

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. George has found somewhere to hide.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八。乔治找到了躲藏的地方。

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. George has found somewhere to hide.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八。乔治找到了躲藏的地方。

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. George has found somewhere to hide.
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八。乔治找到了躲藏的地方。

words.ex: Peppa, you must be very proud of your little brother.
words.exZh: 佩奇，你一定为你的弟弟感到非常骄傲。

words.ex: George, today I'm going to teach you how to paint a flower.
words.exZh: 乔治，今天我要教你画一朵花。

words.ex: Daddy Pig is cleaning a picture. Daddy, this is my secret box. Mummy made it for me.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸在擦一幅画。爸爸，这是我的秘密盒子。妈妈给我做的。

words.ex: Now we can heat up the tomato soup. Ah, listen to the sounds of nature.
words.exZh: 现在我们可以热番茄汤了。啊，听听大自然的声音。

words.ex: We can play Happy Mrs. Chicken later, but now I have to work.
words.exZh: 我们晚一点可以玩《快乐的鸡太太》，但现在我得工作。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: I'll finish the lunch while you mend the computer.
words.exZh: 你修电脑的时候，我把午饭做完。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: Mummy's strawberry? I was just teasing. Mummy's homemade strawberry cake is there, too.
words.exZh: 妈妈的草莓？我刚才是开玩笑的。妈妈自制的草莓蛋糕也在里面。

words.ex: Really? Well, I know a game that will teach George how to catch. It's called Piggy In The Middle.
words.exZh: 真的吗？嗯，我知道有个游戏能教会乔治接球。它叫「中间的小猪」。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Good. You have to throw the ball to each other and I have to try and catch it. I'm the piggy in the middle.
words.exZh: 很好。你们要把球互相传给对方，而我要试着把球抢到。我就是中间的那只小猪。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Oh, dear. Daddy Pig has got the kite caught in a tree.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。猪爸爸把风筝卡在树上了。

words.ex: Whee! George wants to play on the slide. Are you sure, George? It is a bit high. All right, I'll help you up the steps.
words.exZh: 哇！乔治也想玩滑梯。乔治，你确定吗？它有点高。好吧，我扶你上台阶。

words.ex: Daddy Pig wears glasses. He needs to wear glasses to see clearly.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸戴眼镜。他需要戴眼镜才能看清楚。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: I made a box for George, too, and he's filled it with secret things. And only George knows what's inside.
words.exZh: 我也给乔治做了一个盒子，他把秘密的东西都装进去了。而且只有乔治知道里面是什么。

words.ex: Mummy Pig is wearing her hat and scarf and gloves. That is the best snowman I have ever seen!
words.exZh: 猪妈妈戴着她的帽子、围巾和手套。这是我见过最棒的雪人！

words.ex: Oh dear, Daddy Pig cannot see a thing without them, and it makes him very grumpy.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，猪爸爸没有眼镜什么都看不见，这让他脾气很不好。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Oh, dear, everyone is wet! At least the car has been washed.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，大家都湿透了！至少车洗干净了。

words.ex: Danny, Suzy, Rebecca, look. I don't need my stabilizers anymore. Look at me!
words.exZh: 丹尼、苏西、瑞贝卡，快看。我不再需要辅助轮了。看着我！

words.ex: After many days, Grandpa Pig finds a tiny plant growing.
words.exZh: 许多天以后，猪爷爷发现长出了一株小苗。

words.ex: Miss Rabbit, the ice cream lady. On very hot days, Miss Rabbit sells ice cream.
words.exZh: 是卖冰淇淋的兔子小姐。天气特别热的时候，兔子小姐就会来卖冰淇淋。

words.ex: After many days, Grandpa Pig finds a tiny plant growing.
words.exZh: 许多天以后，猪爷爷发现长出了一株小苗。

words.ex: It worked! Now Daddy Pig has his pancake. Daddy has a pancake on his head!
words.exZh: 成功了！现在猪爸爸拿到他的煎饼了。爸爸头上顶着一张煎饼！

words.ex: And now close your eyes and turn around quickly three times.
words.exZh: 然后闭上眼睛，快速地转三圈。

words.ex: Now they make the snowman's head. Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
words.exZh: 现在他们做雪人的头。现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

words.ex: Now wave your arms up and down and stick your tongue out.
words.exZh: 现在上下挥动你的手臂，再把舌头伸出来。

words.ex: No more red spots, you're completely better! Aren't I still a bit ill?
words.exZh: 红斑点都没了，你完全好了！我还算有点病吧？

words.ex: Good. Anyway, now the pumpkin is broken, I can make it into pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 很好。反正南瓜已经坏了，我可以把它做成南瓜派。

words.ex: Do you play it with the proper rules or the baby rules? Proper rules.
words.exZh: 你们是按正式规则玩，还是按小孩子规则玩？正式规则。

words.ex: Oh, I can do it! Look at me. Look at me. I can ride my bike properly.
words.exZh: 哦，我会骑了！看着我。看着我。我能好好骑车了。

words.ex: In future, you really must look where you are going. I promise I will, Daddy.
words.exZh: 以后你真的要看清楚路。我保证我会的，爸爸。

words.ex: Secrets. Mummy Pig has made a special box for Peppa.
words.exZh: 秘密。猪妈妈给佩奇做了一个特别的盒子。

words.ex: We won't all fit. The tent is too little. It will be fine. In you go! Move further in, Mummy Pig.
words.exZh: 我们装不下所有人。帐篷太小了。没问题的。进去吧！猪妈妈，再往里挪一点。

words.ex: Do you have any more secret things? George has a custard donut.
words.exZh: 你们还有别的秘密东西吗？乔治有一个奶油甜甜圈。

words.zh: 塞好（tuck in 盖好被子）
words.ex: Come on, tuck in! Oh, yes, this is a very nice room!
words.exZh: 来吧，尽情享用！哦，没错，这真是个非常棒的房间！

words.ex: Jumping up and down in muddy puddles is just as much fun as flying the kite.
words.exZh: 在泥坑里跳上跳下，跟放风筝一样好玩。

words.ex: Grandad Dog runs the garage. He is very good at mending cars.
words.exZh: 狗爷爷经营着修理厂。他非常擅长修车。

words.ex: This is the best route: keep on the main road until you see Windy Castle up ahead. Thank you, Grandpa Pig.
words.exZh: 这是最好的路线：沿着大路一直走，直到你看见前面的风车城堡。谢谢你，猪爷爷。

words.ex: Please be careful. Just a bit further. Daddy!
words.exZh: 请小心一点。再往前一点点。爸爸！

words.ex: It's only mud. Luckily, Daddy Pig hasn't hurt himself, and the kite is out of the tree.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。幸好猪爸爸没有受伤，风筝也从树上取下来了。

words.ex: I want to eat, then have a nap. I certainly don't want to run around.
words.exZh: 我想吃东西，然后睡个午觉。我可不想跑来跑去。

words.ex: Clever Daddy, you use the duck pond to stop!
words.exZh: 聪明的爸爸，你用鸭子池塘来刹车呀！

words.ex: I'm sure they've had enough. Sorry, Mrs. Duck, we've no more bread.
words.exZh: 我相信它们已经吃饱了。对不起，鸭太太，我们没有面包了。

words.ex: Help! Help! Peppa, George, what's going on? What's all this noise? Whoa! Help!
words.exZh: 救命！救命！佩奇，乔治，发生什么事了？怎么这么吵？哎哟！救命！

words.ex: Musical Instruments. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have been tidying the house.
words.exZh: 乐器。猪妈妈和猪爸爸在收拾屋子。

words.ex: Silly magic Daddy, you said all three colours! Shush, Peppa, don't tell anyone!
words.exZh: 傻乎乎的魔术师爸爸，你把三个颜色全说了一遍！嘘，佩奇，别告诉别人！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Just this horn. Can I try? You have to blow it very hard.
words.exZh: 就剩这个号角了。我能试试吗？你得非常用力地吹。

words.ex: Mummy Pig plays the violin. Daddy Pig plays the accordion. Peppa plays the drum.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈拉小提琴，猪爸爸拉手风琴，佩奇打鼓。

words.ex: George is blowing the horn. Mummy couldn't play the horn, and Daddy couldn't play it, and even I couldn't play it. But George can play it.
words.exZh: 乔治在吹号角。妈妈吹不响，爸爸也吹不响，连我都吹不响。可是乔治会吹。

words.ex: Grandpa, why do butterflies like flowers?
words.exZh: 爷爷，蝴蝶为什么喜欢花呢？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: First, you have to lie down on the ground. Then, you wiggle around.
words.exZh: 首先，你要躺在地上。然后，扭来扭去。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Peppa has found Mummy's makeup box. Aha! First, some powder. Lovely!
words.exZh: 佩奇找到了妈妈的化妆盒。啊哈！先扑点粉。真好看！

words.ex: Goodbye! Daddy Pig is digging in the garden. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George.
words.exZh: 再见！猪爸爸在花园里挖土。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。

words.ex: A very good choice, Peppa. See you later, Peppa. See you later. George, what do you like best?
words.exZh: 佩奇，这个选择很好。待会儿见，佩奇。待会儿见。乔治，你最喜欢什么？

words.ex: Okay. Tigers creep very, very slowly, and then they jump.
words.exZh: 好啊。老虎会非常非常慢地悄悄靠近，然后猛地一跳。

words.ex: Tigers like to lick themselves clean.
words.exZh: 老虎喜欢把自己舔干净。

words.ex: Everyone loves bouncing on the bouncy castle.
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢在充气城堡上蹦跳。

words.ex: Thank you, Miss Rabbit! Enjoy the weather!
words.exZh: 谢谢你，兔子小姐！好好享受这天气吧！

words.ex: Thank you. Mummy Pig loves going to the theater. And Granny Pig and I are going to babysit the little ones.
words.exZh: 谢谢。猪妈妈喜欢去剧院。我和猪奶奶来照看两个小家伙。

words.ex: What a super birthday. I'm the luckiest Mummy in the whole world and the most beautiful.
words.exZh: 多么棒的生日。我是全世界最幸运的妈妈，也是最漂亮的妈妈。

words.ex: Peppa cannot wait to get into bed. Peppa is putting her tooth under the pillow for the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 佩奇迫不及待要上床了。佩奇把牙齿放在枕头底下，等着牙仙来拿。

words.ex: What's wrong, Daddy? Uh, I don't know. Let's take it to Grandad Dog's garage. He can fix it. That's a good idea, Mummy Pig.
words.exZh: 爸爸，怎么了？呃，我不知道。我们把它送到狗爷爷的修理厂去吧。他能修好。猪妈妈，这是个好主意。

words.ex: What a clever car. Wow. When you come back, I will have fixed your car.
words.exZh: 多聪明的车呀。哇。等你们回来，我就把你们的车修好了。

words.ex: One penny and two buttons! Here's your change, one button! Thank you, Mr. Fox!
words.exZh: 一枚便士和两颗纽扣！这是找你的钱，一颗纽扣！谢谢你，狐狸先生！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: Daddy, make the magic windows go down.
words.exZh: 爸爸，把魔法车窗摇下来。

words.ex: First, you have to change into your swimming costumes. Yes, Mummy!
words.exZh: 首先，你们得换上游泳衣。好的，妈妈！

words.ex: Oh! Daddy Pig, please turn off the water! Oh, no need to panic.
words.exZh: 哦！猪爸爸，请把水关掉！哦，不用慌。

words.ex: Peppa and George are following the arrows. Look, George, a key!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治跟着箭头走。乔治你看，一把钥匙！

words.ex: Peppa must stay in bed. I'll call back later to check that she's better. Can Peppa have visitors? Oh, yes, she can have visitors. The rash isn't catching. Goodbye.
words.exZh: 佩奇必须卧床休息。我待会儿再来看看她好些没有。佩奇可以有访客吗？哦，可以，她可以有访客。疹子不传染。再见。

words.ex: I'm afraid it doesn't taste very nice. Open wide, please.
words.exZh: 恐怕这药不太好吃。请把嘴张大。

words.ex: I'm coming to see you! I'm going to wear my nurse's outfit.
words.exZh: 我这就来看你！我要穿上我的护士服。

words.ex: What can we do to make you better? You could get me some orange juice. Okay.
words.exZh: 我们能做点什么让你好受些？你们可以给我拿点橙汁。好的。

words.ex: Chocolate cake! My word, George seems to have got his appetite back!
words.exZh: 巧克力蛋糕！哎呀，乔治好像又有胃口了！

words.ex: Uh, Peppa, George, forget what I just said about Uncle Pig. Okay, Daddy.
words.exZh: 呃，佩奇，乔治，忘了我刚才说的关于猪叔叔的话。好的，爸爸。

words.ex: Now they make the snowman's head. Now he needs arms and eyes and a mouth.
words.exZh: 现在他们做雪人的头。现在他需要手臂、眼睛和嘴巴。

words.ex: Wow, it's so tall. Let's go inside. The view from the top is fantastic.
words.exZh: 哇，它好高啊。我们进去吧。从顶上看出去的风景美极了。

words.zh: 瞧；侦察（I spy 我看见了）
words.ex: Go. I spy with my little eye something blue.
words.exZh: 轮到你了。我用我的小眼睛看见了，一样蓝色的东西。

words.ex: George loves jumping in muddy puddles. Secretly, Peppa would love to jump in the puddle, but she wants to look grown up.
words.exZh: 乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳。佩奇心里其实很想跳，可她想显得像个大孩子。

words.ex: The sky is getting darker and darker. There is going to be a thunderstorm.
words.exZh: 天变得越来越暗了。要下雷阵雨了。

words.ex: We follow the main road and look out for Windy Castle. As I thought.
words.exZh: 我们沿着大路走，留意风车城堡。果然不出我所料。

words.ex: We follow the main road and look out for Windy Castle. As I thought.
words.exZh: 我们沿着大路走，留意风车城堡。果然不出我所料。

words.ex: Wow, it's so tall. Let's go inside. The view from the top is fantastic.
words.exZh: 哇，它好高啊。我们进去吧。从顶上看出去的风景美极了。

words.ex: Let's take a look through the telescope. Can I look first, please? Yes, but you must let George look next.
words.exZh: 我们用望远镜看看吧。我能第一个看吗？可以，不过你要让乔治接着看。

words.ex: Chloé's here! Auntie Pig has brought Chloé to spend the day at Peppa's house.
words.exZh: 克洛伊来啦！猪阿姨把克洛伊带来，在佩奇家玩一天。

words.ex: Chloé is Peppa and George's cousin. Chloé is a bit older than Peppa and George. Hello, Chloé. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George. See you later.
words.exZh: 克洛伊是佩奇和乔治的表姐。克洛伊比佩奇和乔治大一点。你好，克洛伊。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。待会儿见。

words.ex: Peppa holds the hose, and Daddy Pig turns on the water. Where's the water?
words.exZh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪爸爸打开水龙头。水在哪儿呢？

words.ex: Oh, the rain is coming in the house! The floor is getting wet. Oh, dear, what can we do?
words.exZh: 哦，雨水进到屋里来了！地板都湿了。哦，天哪，我们该怎么办？

words.ex: Mummy, can I stir? Yes, of course, Peppa. Peppa loves stirring. George wants to stir as well.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我能搅吗？当然可以，佩奇。佩奇喜欢搅拌。乔治也想搅。

words.ex: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are leaving for their evening out.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸出门去过夜生活了。

words.ex: Good night, my little piggies. Good night, sleep tight. Good night, Mummy. Good night, Daddy.
words.exZh: 晚安，我的小猪们。晚安，睡个好觉。晚安，妈妈。晚安，爸爸。

words.ex: Gardening today. We are talking about roses. Oh, I love gardening programmes.
words.exZh: 今天的园艺节目。我们来聊聊玫瑰。哦，我喜欢园艺节目。

words.ex: Gardening today. We are talking about roses. Oh, I love gardening programmes.
words.exZh: 今天的园艺节目。我们来聊聊玫瑰。哦，我喜欢园艺节目。

words.ex: A dinosaur? Oh, yes, it wasn't a dragon, it was a dinosaur, living outside.
words.exZh: 是恐龙吗？哦，对，那不是龙，是一只恐龙，就住在城堡外面。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Mummy Pig, Peppa and George are sleeping in the tent. Daddy Pig is sleeping outside under the stars.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈、佩奇和乔治睡在帐篷里。猪爸爸睡在外面，头顶是满天星星。

words.ex: He'll get wet. Don't worry, Peppa, Daddy Pig will rescue Teddy. You'd better hurry, Daddy Pig! It's just about to rain.
words.exZh: 他会淋湿的。别担心，佩奇，猪爸爸去把泰迪救回来。猪爸爸，你最好快点！马上就要下雨了。

words.ex: This is Grandpa Pig's vegetable garden. He has grown all these vegetables himself. What's this?
words.exZh: 这是猪爷爷的菜园。这些蔬菜都是他亲手种的。这是什么？

words.ex: Now we can heat up the tomato soup. Ah, listen to the sounds of nature.
words.exZh: 现在我们可以热番茄汤了。啊，听听大自然的声音。

words.ex: We're here! Peppa, George, this is the tent I had when I was a little boy. Daddy, how are you going to make that into a tent?
words.exZh: 我们到啦！佩奇，乔治，这是我小时候用过的帐篷。爸爸，你要怎么把它搭成帐篷呢？

words.ex: Oh, do these pegs do anything? Of course, I forgot about the pegs. The pegs hold the tent up.
words.exZh: 哦，这些地钉有什么用吗？当然有用，我把地钉给忘了。地钉能把帐篷固定住。

words.ex: Okay, now the hard bit! Now that's what I call a blackberry bush! This bush has been here since I was a little piggy! It's an overgrown weed, I should have cut it down years ago!
words.exZh: 好吧，现在是难的部分了！这才配叫黑莓丛呢！我小时候这丛树就在这儿了！它就是一丛疯长的野草，我早该把它砍掉的！

words.ex: Talking of tummies, we should cook supper. Yes, yes! First, we have to collect sticks to make a fire. Yes!
words.exZh: 说到肚子，我们该做晚饭了。对，对！首先，我们得捡些树枝生火。好耶！

words.ex: Good, that's enough sticks. That's a splendid campfire. Now I'll light it.
words.exZh: 好了，树枝够了。这堆篝火真棒。现在我来把它点着。

words.ex: Here are the matches. We don't need matches.
words.exZh: 火柴在这儿。我们不需要火柴。

words.ex: Peppa and George love playing together with Horsey Twinkle Toes!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢一起玩小马闪亮脚趾！

words.ex: Now we can heat up the tomato soup. Ah, listen to the sounds of nature.
words.exZh: 现在我们可以热番茄汤了。啊，听听大自然的声音。

words.ex: A tree house! For George and me! And the little curtains are for your tree house!
words.exZh: 树屋！给乔治和我的！那些小窗帘是给你们树屋用的！

words.ex: Who is it? A young pig named George would like to pay a visit. Can he come in?
words.exZh: 是谁呀？一只叫乔治的小猪想来拜访。他能进来吗？

words.ex: Rebecca, why are you dressed as a carrot? I like carrots!
words.exZh: 瑞贝卡，你为什么扮成胡萝卜呀？因为我喜欢胡萝卜！

words.ex: I'm a witch, I can turn you into a frog!
words.exZh: 我是女巫，我可以把你变成青蛙！

words.ex: Children, children! Sorry, Mummy. Who's next? I'm a clown!
words.exZh: 孩子们，孩子们！对不起，妈妈。下一个是谁？我是小丑！

words.ex: As it's Peppa's party, maybe she should be the judge. I'm the judge! I'm the judge! Daddy, what is a judge? The judge decides who has the best costume. Oh, goody!
words.exZh: 既然这是佩奇的派对，也许该由她来当评委。我是评委！我是评委！爸爸，评委是什么？评委决定谁的服装最好。哦，太好啦！

words.ex: Daddy, what is a museum? It's a place full of interesting things that are very old. Older than you? Yes, even older than me. Ooh! Really old!
words.exZh: 爸爸，博物馆是什么？那是一个装满古老有趣东西的地方。比你还老吗？是的，甚至比我还老。哦！那真是太古老了！

words.ex: Never mind, George, you can share Daddy's ice cream. I'm sure he won't mind.
words.exZh: 没关系，乔治，你可以分爸爸的冰淇淋吃。我肯定他不会介意的。

words.ex: What happened? Huh? Has the puppet show started yet?
words.exZh: 发生什么事了？啊？木偶戏开始了吗？

words.ex: You can tell you two are brothers. Alike in every way. What do you mean? We are completely different.
words.exZh: 看得出来你们俩是兄弟。方方面面都一个样。你什么意思？我们完全不一样好吗。

words.ex: Ho ho! Your daddy's right. I do snore like this.
words.exZh: 呵呵！你爸爸说得对。我打呼噜就是这样的。

words.ex: Daddy Pig is in the sitting room, reading his newspaper. Mummy Pig is reading her book.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸在客厅里看报纸。猪妈妈在看书。

words.ex: Peppa is playing on the swing. Mummy, Mummy, push me, please! Are you ready? Yes, I want to go really high!
words.exZh: 佩奇在荡秋千。妈妈，妈妈，请推我一下！你准备好了吗？准备好了，我想荡得特别高！

words.ex: Peppa, George, would you like to play with your buckets and spades? Yes, please, Mummy!
words.exZh: 佩奇，乔治，你们想玩小桶和铲子吗？想，妈妈！

words.ex: Peppa and George are burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治正在把猪爸爸埋进沙子里。

words.ex: Oh, I just remembered, I think the torch is in the kitchen!
words.exZh: 哦，我想起来了，手电筒好像在厨房里！

words.ex: Welcome aboard, me hearties! Peppa, George, let's put your life jackets on.
words.exZh: 欢迎登船，我的小水手们！佩奇，乔治，来把救生衣穿上。

words.ex: I'm not being towed by that sea dog! I haven't offered to tow the water hog!
words.exZh: 我才不要被那只老水狗拖着走！我又没说过要拖那只水耗子！

words.ex: Petti! What's next on the list, Peppa? Crisps! Crisps are not on the list! We have plenty of crisps at home, Peppa. Have another guess! Hmm, I just can't remember!
words.exZh: 面！佩奇，清单上下一样是什么？薯片！薯片不在清单上！佩奇，家里薯片多着呢。再猜一次！嗯，我记不起来了！

words.ex: This is the checkout, where all the food is paid for. Tomatoes, spaghetti, onions, melon.
words.exZh: 这里是收银台，所有食物都在这儿付钱。西红柿、意大利面、洋葱、西瓜。

words.ex: Okay, Daddy! Ladies and gentlemen... uh, it's magic Daddy!
words.exZh: 好的，爸爸！女士们先生们……呃，是魔术师爸爸！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Okay, Daddy! Ladies and gentlemen... uh, it's magic Daddy!
words.exZh: 好的，爸爸！女士们先生们……呃，是魔术师爸爸！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Ho, ho! For my first trick... abracadabra!
words.exZh: 呵呵！我的第一个魔术……阿布拉卡达布拉！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Who put that there? Oof! Daddy, are you okay? Yes, it's just a bit dark down here!
words.exZh: 是谁把那个放在这儿的？哎哟！爸爸，你没事吧？没事，就是下面有点黑！

words.ex: George, now it's your turn! Dip the stick in the mixture, hold it up, take a big breath, and blow!
words.exZh: 乔治，现在轮到你了！把小棒蘸一下泡泡水，举起来，深吸一口气，然后吹！

words.ex: George is trying really hard, but he is running out of breath!
words.exZh: 乔治非常努力地试了，可他的气不够用了！

words.ex: Then the soap!
words.exZh: 然后是肥皂！

words.ex: And now the tennis racket, please! Thank you! Now watch this!
words.exZh: 现在请给我网球拍！谢谢！大家看好啦！

words.ex: And now the tennis racket, please! Thank you! Now watch this!
words.exZh: 现在请给我网球拍！谢谢！大家看好啦！

words.ex: Everyone loves jumping up and down in muddy bubbly puddles!
words.exZh: 大家都喜欢在满是泡泡的泥坑里跳上跳下！

words.ex: Dinosaur! George, you must stay on your side of the bedroom. That's your side, and this is my side!
words.exZh: 恐龙！乔治，你必须待在卧室你那一边。那是你那边，这是我这边！

words.ex: Oh, there's a letter, too! Dear Peppa and George, here is a present for you to share! Love from Auntie Dottie! Auntie Dottie lives far away in another country!
words.exZh: 哦，还有一封信呢！亲爱的佩奇和乔治，这是送给你们俩一起分享的礼物！爱你们的朵蒂姑姑！朵蒂姑姑住在很远的另一个国家！

words.ex: Oh, dear, Mummy Pig has fallen into the blackberry bush! Mummy, can you get out? Uh, no, I'm stuck! You're stuck in a thorny bush, like Sleeping Beauty!
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，猪妈妈掉进黑莓丛里了！妈妈，你能出来吗？呃，不行，我卡住了！你卡在一丛带刺的灌木里，就像睡美人一样！

words.ex: Oh, another glass vase! It's a grown-up present. That's why it's a bit boring. It's lovely! We'll put it with our other glass vases! George and me bought you a present, too! I hope you like it!
words.exZh: 哦，又一个玻璃花瓶！这是送大人的礼物。所以它才有点无聊。真好看！我们把它和其他玻璃花瓶放在一起吧！我和乔治也给你们买了一件礼物！希望你们喜欢！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: Hello, my little ones! Happy anniversary!
words.exZh: 你们好，我的小宝贝们！结婚纪念日快乐！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: Do Granny and Grandpa like antiques? What does antique mean? Antique means old and rare! Usually, yes! But my antiques are brand new! That chair comes in a set of twelve! Nice, isn't it? Is it made of oak? Yes, it's made of plastic oak! Is it comfortable? You mustn't sit on it! Antique chairs are not for sitting on! So, what do you do with them? You look at them! That's not much fun, even for a grown-up!
words.exZh: 爷爷奶奶喜欢古董吗？古董是什么意思？古董就是又老又稀有！通常是这样！不过我这些古董是全新的！那把椅子是十二件套里的呢！挺好看的，是不是？它是橡木做的吗？是的，是塑料橡木做的！那坐着舒服吗？你可千万别坐上去！古董椅子不是用来坐的！那你们用它做什么？就看着呀！那可没什么意思，就连大人也会觉得无聊！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：狐狸先生的商店

words.ex: School Play. Peppa's playgroup are going to put on a play: The Little Red Riding Hood! Hooray! All the children have parts in the play! They have to practise at home!
words.exZh: 校园剧。佩奇的幼儿园要上演一出剧：《小红帽》！太好啦！所有孩子都有角色！他们得在家里练习！

words.ex: Um, oh, dear, Danny has forgotten what he says next! Grandma, you must go in the cupboard! Go in the cupboard!
words.exZh: 嗯，哦，天哪，丹尼忘了下一句该说什么了！外婆，你必须进柜子里去！进柜子里去！

words.ex: Goodness me! Daddy! Daddy! Guess what we have been doing?
words.exZh: 我的天哪！爸爸！爸爸！猜猜我们刚才在做什么？

words.ex: It's only mud. Let's clean up quickly before Mummy sees the mess.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。我们赶紧清理干净，别让妈妈看到这团乱。

words.ex: Sometimes, George likes to scare Peppa with Mr. Dinosaur.
words.exZh: 有时候，乔治喜欢用恐龙先生吓佩奇。

words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: At supper time, Mr. Dinosaur sits next to George.
words.exZh: 吃晚饭的时候，恐龙先生坐在乔治旁边。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: I beg your pardon? Was that you, George? Or was it Mr. Dinosaur?
words.exZh: 不好意思，打扰一下。那是你吗，乔治？还是恐龙先生？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: I beg your pardon? Was that you, George? Or was it Mr. Dinosaur?
