words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: George's favourite game is throwing Mr. Dinosaur up in the air and catching him when he falls back down.
words.exZh: 乔治最喜欢的游戏是把恐龙先生抛到空中，等他掉下来时再接住。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Peppa and Daddy Pig are playing draughts.
words.exZh: 佩奇和猪爸爸在下跳棋。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: A detective is a very important person who is good at finding things.
words.exZh: 侦探是很重要的人，擅长找东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Maybe the detective should ask George some simple questions.
words.exZh: 也许侦探应该问乔治一些简单的问题。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: I wonder if this time you threw Mr. Dinosaur just a bit too high.
words.exZh: 我在想，这次你是不是把他抛得太高了一点。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mr Dinosaur is Lost
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：恐龙先生不见了

words.ex: Why don't you and Susie go and play in your bedroom? Yes, Mommy.
words.exZh: 你和苏西为什么不去你们的房间玩呢？好的，妈妈。

words.ex: No, George, this game is just for big girls.
words.exZh: 不行，乔治，这个游戏只给大女孩玩。

words.ex: I'm going to wave my magic wand and turn you into a frog!
words.exZh: 我要挥动我的魔法棒，把你变成一只青蛙！

words.ex: Tigers like to lick themselves clean.
words.exZh: 老虎喜欢把自己舔干净。

words.ex: First, I put some flour in the bowl. Ooh! Now I add an egg. Now the milk, and I give it all a stir.
words.exZh: 首先，我在碗里放些面粉。哦！现在加一个鸡蛋。现在加牛奶，然后全部搅一搅。

words.ex: Hello, Suzy. Hello, Peppa. I'm not very well. I have red spots on my face. Has the doctor been?
words.exZh: 你好，苏西。你好，佩奇。我不太舒服。我脸上有红色的斑点。医生来看过了吗？

words.ex: Peppa listens to George's chest.
words.exZh: 佩奇听乔治的胸口。

words.ex: Can the patient have a visitor?
words.exZh: 病人可以有访客吗？

words.ex: Peppa wanted to copy George, but she's too big and has got stuck.
words.exZh: 佩奇想学乔治的样子，可是她太大了，卡住了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Peppa and George are pretending to be parrots.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治在假装自己是鹦鹉。

words.ex: But we're waiting for my strawberry plant to grow. I wanted strawberries for tea.
words.exZh: 可是我们在等我的草莓长大呢。我还想吃点心的时候吃草莓。

words.ex: A dinosaur! George loves dinosaurs! George is eating the tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber!
words.exZh: 恐龙！乔治最喜欢恐龙了！乔治正在吃西红柿、生菜和黄瓜呢！

words.ex: Peppa and George love eating chocolate cake, but today they were in a hurry to get back and play with Polly Parrot.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治很喜欢吃巧克力蛋糕，但今天他们急着回去和波莉鹦鹉玩。

words.ex: Chocolate cake! My word, George seems to have got his appetite back!
words.exZh: 巧克力蛋糕！哎呀，乔治好像又有胃口了！

words.ex: I'm sure he'll be better this time. Close your eyes and start counting.
words.exZh: 我肯定他这次会好一点。闭上眼睛开始数数吧。

words.ex: Can't catch me! George, I'm going to easily catch you. You're so little.
words.exZh: 抓不到我！乔治，我轻轻松松就能抓到你。你太小了。

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Ready or not, here I come!
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。不管准备好了没有，我来了！

words.ex: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Ready or not, here I come!
words.exZh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。不管准备好了没有，我来了！

words.ex: Actually, I think there's something about George in this newspaper.
words.exZh: 其实，我觉着这张报纸上有点乔治的线索。

words.ex: Madam Gazelle looks after the children at the playgroup.
words.exZh: 羚羊夫人在幼儿园照顾孩子们。

words.ex: I think George and Peppa's pictures should go on the wall.
words.exZh: 我觉得乔治和佩奇的画应该贴到墙上去。

words.ex: What do you like best? The face painting.
words.exZh: 你们最喜欢什么？画脸。

words.ex: George has found the second clue: sticks in the shape of an arrow. Look, they point this way.
words.exZh: 乔治找到了第二条线索：摆成箭头形状的树枝。看，它们指向这边。

words.ex: I think George and Peppa's pictures should go on the wall.
words.exZh: 我觉得乔治和佩奇的画应该贴到墙上去。

words.ex: Peppa and George loved to watch Mummy work on the computer.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治很喜欢看妈妈在电脑上工作。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: And, George, you mustn't touch the computer, either.
words.exZh: 还有乔治，你也不能碰电脑。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: Sorry, Mummy. I was just showing George what not to do.
words.exZh: 对不起，妈妈。我只是在给乔治演示什么不能做。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Mummy Pig at Work

words.ex: You can go out to play when you finish your breakfast.
words.exZh: 你们吃完早餐就可以出去玩了。

words.ex: Not really, Mummy. I was teaching him how to catch.
words.exZh: 其实没有，妈妈。我是在教他怎么接球。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Hurray!
words.exZh: 太好啦！
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Piggy in the Middle

words.ex: Daddy Pig wears glasses. He needs to wear glasses to see clearly.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸戴眼镜。他需要戴眼镜才能看清楚。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: This is ridiculous! I can't see anything! Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
words.exZh: 太荒唐了！我什么都看不见！一定有人把我的眼镜放到别的地方去了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Peppa and George are looking in the bathroom. The glasses are not in the bath.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治在浴室里找。眼镜不在浴缸里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: We've looked everywhere, but we can't find Daddy's glasses. Oh dear, now what can we do?
words.exZh: 我们到处都找过了，可就是找不到爸爸的眼镜。哦，天哪，现在我们该怎么办？
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: I suppose I'll just have to learn to do without them. If I move slowly, I won't bump into things.
words.exZh: 我想我只能学着没有眼镜过日子了。如果我慢慢走，就不会撞到东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: I just make a little hole and put the seed in. Then I cover it with earth and water it.
words.exZh: 我先挖一个小坑，把种子放进去。然后盖上土，再浇水。

words.ex: Everything in my garden grows from tiny seeds like these.
words.exZh: 我花园里的每一样东西，都是从这样的小种子长出来的。

words.ex: Rub the top of your head and rub your tummy.
words.exZh: 摸摸你的头顶，再揉揉你的肚子。

words.ex: George is trying really hard, but he is running out of breath!
words.exZh: 乔治非常努力地试了，可他的气不够用了！

words.ex: It is a lovely sunny day, and Peppa and George are riding their bicycles.
words.exZh: 今天阳光明媚，佩奇和乔治在骑他们的自行车。

words.ex: Pumpkins are the only thing I can grow. Probably because I love pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 南瓜是我唯一能种出来的东西。大概是因为我太喜欢南瓜派了。

words.ex: So don't be sad if she finds you too little to play with. Oh, I'm sure Chloé will play with both of you.
words.exZh: 所以如果她觉得你太小、不想跟你玩，你们也别难过。哦，我相信克洛伊会跟你们两个一起玩的。

words.ex: Peppa wishes she did not have stabilizers on her bicycle.
words.exZh: 佩奇真希望自己的自行车上没有辅助轮。

words.ex: Daddy, you let go! You've been cycling on your own for ages.
words.exZh: 爸爸，你松手了！你已经自己骑了好久了。

words.ex: Oh dear. Peppa has squashed Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。佩奇把猪爸爸的南瓜压扁了。

words.ex: Children, it's time to decide who has the best fancy dress costume. We need a judge.
words.exZh: 孩子们，现在该选出谁的化装服最棒了。我们需要一位评委。

words.ex: George, this is my secret box. It's empty. I have to find some things to put inside.
words.exZh: 乔治，这是我的秘密盒子。它是空的。我得找些东西放进去。

words.ex: Wow! Oh, oh, Peppa, the butterfly thinks you're a flower. I'm not a flower. I'm Peppa Pig.
words.exZh: 哇！哦，哦，佩奇，蝴蝶以为你是一朵花呢。我不是花。我是小猪佩奇。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Daddy Pig is cleaning a picture. Daddy, this is my secret box. Mummy made it for me.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸在擦一幅画。爸爸，这是我的秘密盒子。妈妈给我做的。

words.ex: The thunderstorm is over. The thunderstorm has filled the garden with muddy puddles.
words.exZh: 雷阵雨过去了。雷阵雨把花园里弄得全是泥坑。

words.ex: Do you have any more secret things? George has a custard donut.
words.exZh: 你们还有别的秘密东西吗？乔治有一个奶油甜甜圈。

words.ex: So oily and yucky! Yuck! What a fuss about nothing. Yes, we all need sun cream today.
words.exZh: 又油又黏，真讨厌！呸！真是小题大做。是的，今天我们全都需要涂防晒霜。

words.ex: Picnic. It is a lovely bright sunny day. Peppa and her family are going for a picnic.
words.exZh: 野餐。今天天气晴朗明媚。佩奇一家要去野餐。

words.ex: George. Thank you, Daddy. Daddy Pig flies the kite.
words.exZh: 乔治。谢谢你，爸爸。猪爸爸放起了风筝。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you are much too heavy for that branch! Nonsense, I know exactly how heavy I am.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，那根树枝可承受不了你的重量！胡说，我清楚自己有多重。

words.ex: It's only mud. Luckily, Daddy Pig hasn't hurt himself, and the kite is out of the tree.
words.exZh: 只是泥而已。幸好猪爸爸没有受伤，风筝也从树上取下来了。

words.ex: Mummy, can we feed the ducks? Yes, you can feed them the rest of the bread.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我们可以喂鸭子吗？可以，你们可以把剩下的面包喂给它们。

words.ex: Mummy, can we feed the ducks? Yes, you can feed them the rest of the bread.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我们可以喂鸭子吗？可以，你们可以把剩下的面包喂给它们。

words.ex: You lot again! Peppa told you there's no more bread.
words.exZh: 又是你们！佩奇说了，没有面包了。

words.ex: Oh, a wasp! I hate wasps. Shoo! What a fuss, Mummy Pig. It's only a little wasp. Go away, wasp!
words.exZh: 哦，一只黄蜂！我讨厌黄蜂。嘘！猪妈妈，真大惊小怪。只是一只小黄蜂。走开，黄蜂！

words.ex: So oily and yucky! Yuck! What a fuss about nothing. Yes, we all need sun cream today.
words.exZh: 又油又黏，真讨厌！呸！真是小题大做。是的，今天我们全都需要涂防晒霜。

words.ex: George is trying really hard, but he is running out of breath!
words.exZh: 乔治非常努力地试了，可他的气不够用了！

words.ex: I've got the key to open it. Wow! I can't believe it! Gold coins! They must be worth a fortune!
words.exZh: 我有打开它的钥匙。哇！我简直不敢相信！金币！它们一定值一大笔钱！

words.ex: Luckily I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
words.exZh: 幸好我总算保住了我那块草莓蛋糕。

words.ex: Musical Instruments. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have been tidying the house.
words.exZh: 乐器。猪妈妈和猪爸爸在收拾屋子。

words.ex: That does not sound right, either. Peppa was right. It is impossible to play.
words.exZh: 这个听起来也不对。佩奇说得对。这根本吹不响。

words.ex: Well, I do play it quite nicely, even if I say so myself. And I'll play my violin. And I will play my drum.
words.exZh: 嗯，我拉得确实挺不错的，虽然是我自己说的。那我拉小提琴。我打我的鼓。

words.ex: Yes, George. Let's play frogs. I'm a little froggie.
words.exZh: 好呀，乔治。我们来扮青蛙。我是一只小青蛙。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：青蛙、虫子和蝴蝶

words.ex: Peppa is enjoying pretending to be Mummy Pig, but George is getting a bit bored.
words.exZh: 佩奇很喜欢假装成猪妈妈，可乔治有点无聊了。

words.ex: That's very kind of you, Daddy Pig. Now, be careful, it's a very deep hole.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你真是太好了。现在小心点，这个洞很深。

words.ex: We don't know. Oh, well, that's a shame, because I've got their favorite ice cream here.
words.exZh: 我们不知道。哦，那太可惜了，因为我这儿有他们最爱吃的冰淇淋。

words.ex: There we go! You look very smart in your water wings, George.
words.exZh: 好啦！乔治，你戴着游泳圈看起来真神气。

words.ex: Peppa cannot wait to get into bed. Peppa is putting her tooth under the pillow for the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 佩奇迫不及待要上床了。佩奇把牙齿放在枕头底下，等着牙仙来拿。

words.ex: Can George and I get our faces painted first? Of course.
words.exZh: 我和乔治可以先画脸吗？当然可以。

words.ex: Peppa, would you like your face painted? Yes, please. Can I be an elephant?
words.exZh: 佩奇，你想画脸吗？想。我能画成大象吗？

words.ex: Dinosaur. A dinosaur? Uh, how about a tiger instead? I'm good at tigers.
words.exZh: 恐龙。恐龙？呃，要不画老虎吧？我擅长画老虎。

words.ex: Tigers don't say woof woof. How do you know?
words.exZh: 老虎不会汪汪叫。你怎么知道的？

words.ex: Hello, Madame Gazelle. We'd like some balloons, please.
words.exZh: 你好，羚羊夫人。我们想要一些气球。

words.ex: Can I have a kangaroo? A lion, please. A monkey, please. A parrot, please.
words.exZh: 我可以要袋鼠吗？请给我狮子。请给我猴子。请给我鹦鹉。

words.ex: Oh! Oh! Mummy, Daddy, it's gone all dark, and the music has broken! And my vacuum won't work! And my computer has switched off!
words.exZh: 啊！啊！妈妈，爸爸，到处都黑了，音乐也停了！我的吸尘器也用不了了！我的电脑也关机了！

words.ex: I see. And what are the secret words? I have to whisper them to you. The secret words are: Daddy's big tummy!
words.exZh: 我明白了。那暗号是什么呢？我得悄悄告诉你。暗号是：爸爸的大肚子！

words.ex: Do I have any choice? Nope. Bye-bye, Mummy. Have a lovely walk. We'll call you when it's safe to come back in.
words.exZh: 我有别的选择吗？没有。再见，妈妈。散步愉快。安全了我们就叫你进来。

words.ex: Hello, Mummy Pig. Hello, Miss Rabbit. How many tickets, please? Two adults and two children.
words.exZh: 你好，猪妈妈。你好，兔子小姐。请问要几张票？两张成人票和两张儿童票。

words.ex: Tooth Fairy? Yes, the Tooth Fairy. If you put the tooth under your pillow tonight, the Tooth Fairy will come.
words.exZh: 牙仙？是的，牙仙。如果你今晚把牙齿放在枕头底下，牙仙就会来。

words.ex: Thank you. Mummy Pig loves going to the theater. And Granny Pig and I are going to babysit the little ones.
words.exZh: 谢谢。猪妈妈喜欢去剧院。我和猪奶奶来照看两个小家伙。

words.ex: What a super birthday. I'm the luckiest Mummy in the whole world and the most beautiful.
words.exZh: 多么棒的生日。我是全世界最幸运的妈妈，也是最漂亮的妈妈。

words.ex: First, I put some flour in the bowl. Ooh! Now I add an egg. Now the milk, and I give it all a stir.
words.exZh: 首先，我在碗里放些面粉。哦！现在加一个鸡蛋。现在加牛奶，然后全部搅一搅。

words.ex: The Tooth Fairy will take the tooth, and in its place she will leave a shiny coin.
words.exZh: 牙仙会把牙齿带走，然后在原来的地方留下一枚亮闪闪的硬币。

words.ex: Quick, George, it's bedtime. We don't want to miss the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 快点，乔治，该睡觉了。我们可不想错过牙仙。

words.ex: This Tooth Fairy is very late. The Tooth Fairy is taking a long, long time to arrive. Where is that Tooth Fairy?
words.exZh: 这个牙仙来得真晚。牙仙花了好久好久才到。那个牙仙到底在哪儿？

words.ex: Grandad Dog runs the garage. He is very good at mending cars.
words.exZh: 狗爷爷经营着修理厂。他非常擅长修车。

words.ex: Can you fix it, please, Grandad Dog? Yes, but it will take all day. Oh, we wanted to go for a drive in our car. Don't worry. You can borrow this new car while I fix yours.
words.exZh: 狗爷爷，请帮我修一下好吗？可以，不过要修一整天。哦，我们还想开车去兜风呢。别担心。我修你们车的时候，你们可以先借用这辆新车。

words.ex: Daddy, you must not take photos! Oops! Sorry, Peppa! Carry on!
words.exZh: 爸爸，你不能拍照！哎哟！对不起，佩奇！继续吧！

words.ex: Peppa and George are burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治正在把猪爸爸埋进沙子里。

words.ex: You started too soon! Catch me if you can, water hog! Sea dog, is that as fast as you can go?
words.exZh: 你抢跑了！有本事就追上我，水耗子！老水狗，你就这点速度吗？

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you're holding the map upside down! Yes, I thought as much.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你把地图拿反了！是的，我也觉得是。

words.ex: Do not cross the invisible line!
words.exZh: 不许越过这条看不见的线！

words.ex: The pirate's handwriting is excellent! No, I can't make it out at all.
words.exZh: 海盗的字写得棒极了！不对，我根本看不出来。

words.ex: We follow the main road and look out for Windy Castle. As I thought.
words.exZh: 我们沿着大路走，留意风车城堡。果然不出我所料。

words.ex: Peppa and George are following the arrows. Look, George, a key!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治跟着箭头走。乔治你看，一把钥匙！

words.ex: George has found the second clue: sticks in the shape of an arrow. Look, they point this way.
words.exZh: 乔治找到了第二条线索：摆成箭头形状的树枝。看，它们指向这边。

words.ex: I've got the key to open it. Wow! I can't believe it! Gold coins! They must be worth a fortune!
words.exZh: 我有打开它的钥匙。哇！我简直不敢相信！金币！它们一定值一大笔钱！

words.ex: Hello, Grandpa Pig speaking. Grandpa Pig, we've got a bit lost on the way to Windy Castle.
words.exZh: 喂，我是猪爷爷。猪爷爷，我们在去风车城堡的路上有点迷路了。

words.ex: What is that? It looks like a horrible monster!
words.exZh: 那是什么？看起来像个可怕的怪物！

words.ex: Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves. Come on, George!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治得戴上帽子、围巾和手套。快点，乔治！

words.ex: Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves. Come on, George!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治得戴上帽子、围巾和手套。快点，乔治！

words.ex: Peppa and George love making footprints in the snow.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在雪地上踩脚印。

words.ex: Peppa and George are making a snowman. First, they make the body. George, this is the snowman's body.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治在堆雪人。首先，他们做身体。乔治，这是雪人的身体。

words.ex: This is his face. Now the snowman needs a nose.
words.exZh: 这是他的脸。现在雪人还需要一个鼻子。

words.ex: Windy Castle sounds like a boring place for boys.
words.exZh: 风车城堡听起来是个很无聊的地方，只有男孩子才喜欢。

words.ex: Look at the view. Mummy, is that Granny and Grandpa's house? Yes, it is. It's so far away.
words.exZh: 快看这风景。妈妈，那是爷爷奶奶家吗？是的。好远啊。

words.ex: Go. I spy with my little eye something blue.
words.exZh: 轮到你了。我用我的小眼睛看见了，一样蓝色的东西。

words.ex: Oh, Daddy Pig! We're lost! We are not lost! So how do we get to Windy Castle from here? Just give me a moment. Hmm.
words.exZh: 哦，猪爸爸！我们迷路了！我们没有迷路！那从这里怎么去风车城堡？给我一点时间。嗯。

words.ex: This is the best route: keep on the main road until you see Windy Castle up ahead. Thank you, Grandpa Pig.
words.exZh: 这是最好的路线：沿着大路一直走，直到你看见前面的风车城堡。谢谢你，猪爷爷。

words.ex: Wow, the telescope makes everything look bigger. I can see Granny and Grandpa. Look, George!
words.exZh: 哇，望远镜把所有东西都放大了。我能看到爷爷和奶奶。乔治你看！

words.ex: George is waving at Granny and Grandpa. Silly George. Granny and Grandpa are too far away to see you waving.
words.exZh: 乔治在朝爷爷奶奶挥手。傻乔治。爷爷奶奶离得太远了，看不见你挥手。

words.ex: Chloé's here! Auntie Pig has brought Chloé to spend the day at Peppa's house.
words.exZh: 克洛伊来啦！猪阿姨把克洛伊带来，在佩奇家玩一天。

words.ex: Chloé's here! Auntie Pig has brought Chloé to spend the day at Peppa's house.
words.exZh: 克洛伊来啦！猪阿姨把克洛伊带来，在佩奇家玩一天。

words.ex: I'll start. Peppa, you're it! Catch me if you can! Peppa is it. She has to chase Chloé and George.
words.exZh: 我先来。佩奇，你来抓！有本事就抓到我！佩奇来抓人。她得去追克洛伊和乔治。

words.ex: It's not fair! You look too long. The rules say I can look as long as I want. Back to the start!
words.exZh: 这不公平！你看得太久了。规则说我想看多久就看多久。退回起点！

words.ex: Peppa is the sly fox. While her back is turned, the others creep up on her. But if Peppa turns and sees someone move, they have to go back to the start.
words.exZh: 佩奇当狡猾的狐狸。她背过身去的时候，其他人悄悄靠近她。但如果佩奇转过身看见有人在动，那个人就得退回起点。

words.ex: I love pancakes. Everyone loves pancakes. I'm the expert at flipping the pancakes over. Leave that to me.
words.exZh: 我喜欢煎饼。大家都喜欢煎饼。我最擅长给煎饼翻面了。交给我吧。

words.ex: Oh, dear. George has dropped his sponge in a muddy puddle.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。乔治把海绵掉进泥坑里了。

words.ex: Mummy, can I stir? Yes, of course, Peppa. Peppa loves stirring. George wants to stir as well.
words.exZh: 妈妈，我能搅吗？当然可以，佩奇。佩奇喜欢搅拌。乔治也想搅。

words.ex: No, George, like this. Okay, that's enough stirring, you two. Sit at the table while I cook the pancakes.
words.exZh: 不对，乔治，要像这样。好了，你们俩搅够了。坐到桌边去，我来烙煎饼。

words.ex: This first pancake is for George. Mummy Pig pours a little syrup on George's pancake.
words.exZh: 第一张煎饼给乔治。猪妈妈在乔治的煎饼上浇了一点糖浆。

words.ex: Peppa and George are so good, they just fell asleep when Mummy Pig told them to. This babysitting is easy.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治真乖，猪妈妈一叫他们睡就睡着了。照看孩子真容易。

words.ex: Gardening today. We are talking about roses. Oh, I love gardening programmes.
words.exZh: 今天的园艺节目。我们来聊聊玫瑰。哦，我喜欢园艺节目。

words.ex: Hooray! Icelandic roses are a rare treat for the discerning horticulturalist, but they are prone to drooping in temperate habitats.
words.exZh: 太好啦！冰岛玫瑰对有品位的园艺爱好者来说是难得的享受，不过它们在温带气候里容易垂头。

words.ex: When Captain Grandpa tells you all to do something, you must do it, unless it's something silly.
words.exZh: 当船长爷爷吩咐你们做什么事，你们就必须做，除非那事很傻。

words.zh: 一次；从前（once upon a time）
words.ex: Hmm, the Sleepy Princess. Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a little princess, and she was called the Sleepy Princess.
words.exZh: 嗯，瞌睡公主。很久很久以前，在一座城堡里住着一位小公主，大家都叫她瞌睡公主。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Hmm, the Sleepy Princess. Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a little princess, and she was called the Sleepy Princess.
words.exZh: 嗯，瞌睡公主。很久很久以前，在一座城堡里住着一位小公主，大家都叫她瞌睡公主。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: A dinosaur? Oh, yes, it wasn't a dragon, it was a dinosaur, living outside.
words.exZh: 是恐龙吗？哦，对，那不是龙，是一只恐龙，就住在城堡外面。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Was it a huge fierce dinosaur? Maybe the dinosaur isn't quite that fierce, Daddy Pig. Sorry, George.
words.exZh: 是一只又大又凶的恐龙吗？猪爸爸，也许那只恐龙没那么凶。对不起，乔治。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: The princess! I'm coming to that. You see, the sun set, and the stars and moon came out, and everyone got very sleepy.
words.exZh: 公主呢！我正要讲到那儿。你看，太阳落山了，星星和月亮出来了，大家都变得特别困。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: The princess! I'm coming to that. You see, the sun set, and the stars and moon came out, and everyone got very sleepy.
words.exZh: 公主呢！我正要讲到那儿。你看，太阳落山了，星星和月亮出来了，大家都变得特别困。
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爱睡觉的公主

words.ex: Peppa quite enjoyed the powercut, but she's happy the electricity is back again!
words.exZh: 佩奇还挺喜欢这次停电的，不过电回来了她也很开心！

words.ex: Mummy, there was a loud bang! It's thunder, Peppa. It means there will be a thunderstorm with lots of rain. Quick, into the house before the rain starts!
words.exZh: 妈妈，刚才有一声巨响！佩奇，那是打雷。这意味着要下雷阵雨了，还有大雨。快点，趁还没下雨进屋去！

words.ex: Mummy, there was a loud bang! It's thunder, Peppa. It means there will be a thunderstorm with lots of rain. Quick, into the house before the rain starts!
words.exZh: 妈妈，刚才有一声巨响！佩奇，那是打雷。这意味着要下雷阵雨了，还有大雨。快点，趁还没下雨进屋去！

words.ex: Mummy, there was a loud bang! It's thunder, Peppa. It means there will be a thunderstorm with lots of rain. Quick, into the house before the rain starts!
words.exZh: 妈妈，刚才有一声巨响！佩奇，那是打雷。这意味着要下雷阵雨了，还有大雨。快点，趁还没下雨进屋去！

words.ex: The sky is getting darker and darker. There is going to be a thunderstorm.
words.exZh: 天变得越来越暗了。要下雷阵雨了。

words.ex: I love thunderstorms! They make muddy puddles! Splish, splash, splash!
words.exZh: 我喜欢雷阵雨！它们能造出泥坑！噗嗤，啪嗒，啪嗒！

words.ex: I know all about thunderstorms. It won't rain for ages. As I thought, plenty of time before it rains.
words.exZh: 我对雷阵雨了如指掌。一时半会儿还下不了雨。果然不出我所料，离下雨还早着呢。

words.ex: Poor Teddy, he's soaking wet! Yes, poor Teddy. Let's get him dry.
words.exZh: 可怜的泰迪，他全身都湿透了！是啊，可怜的泰迪。我们把他弄干吧。

words.ex: Cleaning the Car. Daddy Pig is taking the family for a drive in the country. Come on, is everybody ready? Ready! Yes, Daddy Pig, we're ready.
words.exZh: 洗车。猪爸爸要带全家去乡下兜风。来吧，大家都准备好了吗？准备好了！是的，猪爸爸，我们准备好了。

words.ex: Peppa holds the hose, and Daddy Pig turns on the water. Where's the water?
words.exZh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪爸爸打开水龙头。水在哪儿呢？

words.ex: Oh, dear, everyone is wet! At least the car has been washed.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，大家都湿透了！至少车洗干净了。

words.ex: Granny Pig has made pizza for lunch, and here's some salad made with Grandpa Pig's tomatoes, lettuce and cucumber. Tuck in, everyone!
words.exZh: 猪奶奶做了披萨当午饭，还有用猪爷爷种的西红柿、生菜和黄瓜做的沙拉。大家尽情吃吧！

words.ex: So oily and yucky! Yuck! What a fuss about nothing. Yes, we all need sun cream today.
words.exZh: 又油又黏，真讨厌！呸！真是小题大做。是的，今天我们全都需要涂防晒霜。

words.ex: Talking of tummies, we should cook supper. Yes, yes! First, we have to collect sticks to make a fire. Yes!
words.exZh: 说到肚子，我们该做晚饭了。对，对！首先，我们得捡些树枝生火。好耶！

words.ex: Daddy, how can you light it without matches? I'm going to make fire the old way, by simply rubbing these two sticks together.
words.exZh: 爸爸，没有火柴你怎么点火？我要用最老的办法生火，就是把这两根树枝互相摩擦。

words.ex: Daddy, you're too big for the tent! Never mind, I'd rather sleep outside anyway. Good night, Daddy Pig! Good night, Daddy! Night night! Good night, everyone!
words.exZh: 爸爸，你太大了，帐篷装不下你！没关系，反正我更想睡在外面。晚安，猪爸爸！晚安，爸爸！晚安！大家晚安！

words.ex: What's that sound? It sounds like snoring.
words.exZh: 那是什么声音？听起来像打呼噜。

words.ex: Who is it? A young pig named George would like to pay a visit. Can he come in?
words.exZh: 是谁呀？一只叫乔治的小猪想来拜访。他能进来吗？

words.ex: Yes, we forgot Daddy Pig! Hey! What? Daddy, we almost left you behind, but George remembered you! Well, I'm glad George remembered me!
words.exZh: 是啊，我们把猪爸爸忘了！喂！什么？爸爸，我们差点把你落下了，是乔治想起了你！嗯，我很高兴乔治还记得我！

words.ex: Very good. My, my, who have we here? I'm a pirate! Shiver me timbers!
words.exZh: 非常好。哎呀，我们这儿还有谁呀？我是海盗！嘿哟嘿哟！

words.zh: 木材（shiver me timbers 水手惊叹语）
words.ex: Very good. My, my, who have we here? I'm a pirate! Shiver me timbers!
words.exZh: 非常好。哎呀，我们这儿还有谁呀？我是海盗！嘿哟嘿哟！

words.ex: Fantastic! Come in, there's a fairy princess and a dinosaur waiting to meet you.
words.exZh: 太棒了！进来吧，有一位仙女公主和一只恐龙正等着见你们呢。

words.ex: You must bow when you speak to me. Hello, Your Majesty. Hmm... I'm Nurse Susie. Open wide and say ah.
words.exZh: 你跟我说话的时候必须鞠躬。你好，公主殿下。嗯……我是护士苏西。张大嘴说「啊」。

words.ex: You must bow when you speak to me. Hello, Your Majesty. Hmm... I'm Nurse Susie. Open wide and say ah.
words.exZh: 你跟我说话的时候必须鞠躬。你好，公主殿下。嗯……我是护士苏西。张大嘴说「啊」。

words.ex: Oh, dear, George is scared of his own reflection. Oh, silly George, look, it's you in the mirror!
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，乔治被自己的倒影吓到了。哦，傻乔治，你看，镜子里那就是你自己呀！

words.ex: Thank you. Peppa loves fancy dress parties.
words.exZh: 谢谢。佩奇喜欢化装舞会。

words.ex: Peppa wants to see the room full of things that belong to kings and queens from long ago. Wow! But George wants to see the real dinosaur.
words.exZh: 佩奇想去看那个装满很久以前国王和王后用品的房间。哇！可乔治想去看真正的恐龙。

words.ex: Peppa wants to see the room full of things that belong to kings and queens from long ago. Wow! But George wants to see the real dinosaur.
words.exZh: 佩奇想去看那个装满很久以前国王和王后用品的房间。哇！可乔治想去看真正的恐龙。

words.ex: Peppa wants to see the room full of things that belong to kings and queens from long ago. Wow! But George wants to see the real dinosaur.
words.exZh: 佩奇想去看那个装满很久以前国王和王后用品的房间。哇！可乔治想去看真正的恐龙。

words.ex: Peppa, these are all the things that the queen had a long time ago. This is the queen's special chair, it's called a throne. It's beautiful!
words.exZh: 佩奇，这些都是很久以前王后的东西。这是王后专属的椅子，它叫宝座。真漂亮！

words.ex: Mummy, where is the queen's television? They didn't have television then. No television? But they did have computers? No, they didn't have computers either.
words.exZh: 妈妈，王后的电视在哪儿呢？那时候还没有电视。没有电视？那他们有电脑吧？不，他们也没有电脑。

words.ex: Dinosaur! George imagines being a big dinosaur.
words.exZh: 恐龙！乔治在想象自己变成一只大恐龙。

words.ex: First, you have to change into your swimming costumes. Yes, Mummy!
words.exZh: 首先，你们得换上游泳衣。好的，妈妈！

words.ex: Miss Rabbit, the ice cream lady. On very hot days, Miss Rabbit sells ice cream.
words.exZh: 是卖冰淇淋的兔子小姐。天气特别热的时候，兔子小姐就会来卖冰淇淋。

words.ex: Miss Rabbit, the ice cream lady. On very hot days, Miss Rabbit sells ice cream.
words.exZh: 是卖冰淇淋的兔子小姐。天气特别热的时候，兔子小姐就会来卖冰淇淋。

words.ex: Mummy, Daddy, can George and I have an ice cream, please? Oh, well, I suppose it is an especially hot day. Yes, please!
words.exZh: 妈妈，爸爸，我和乔治能吃冰淇淋吗？哦，好吧，今天确实特别热。好吧，买！

words.ex: George, you should eat your ice lolly before it melts. Thank you! George loves his dinosaur ice lolly so much, he doesn't want to eat it.
words.exZh: 乔治，你该趁冰棍还没化把它吃了。谢谢！乔治太喜欢他的恐龙冰棍了，都舍不得吃。

words.ex: Uncle Pig, are you going to fall asleep and snore like you always do? What do you mean? Daddy says you always fall asleep and snore loudly like this.
words.exZh: 猪叔叔，你又要像每次那样睡着打呼噜了吗？你什么意思？爸爸说你总是睡着，呼噜打得震天响，就像这样。

words.ex: Chloe, can me and George make puppets, too? Yes.
words.exZh: 克洛伊，我和乔治也能做木偶吗？可以呀。

words.ex: You can tell you two are brothers. Alike in every way. What do you mean? We are completely different.
words.exZh: 看得出来你们俩是兄弟。方方面面都一个样。你什么意思？我们完全不一样好吗。

words.ex: You can tell you two are brothers. Alike in every way. What do you mean? We are completely different.
words.exZh: 看得出来你们俩是兄弟。方方面面都一个样。你什么意思？我们完全不一样好吗。

words.ex: Someone did trip over and hurt themselves! Oh, dear, poor Daddy Pig! Come on, children, let's do a bit of tidying up.
words.exZh: 已经有人被绊倒受伤啦！哦，天哪，可怜的猪爸爸！来吧，孩子们，我们来收拾一下。

words.ex: But Mummy, we're playing dollies and dinosaurs! You can play again when you've tidied up.
words.exZh: 可是妈妈，我们在玩娃娃和恐龙呢！收拾好你们就可以接着玩。

words.ex: This is a Tyrannosaurus Rex! Tyrannosaurus Rex! That's right!
words.exZh: 这是霸王龙！霸王龙！答对了！

words.ex: This is a Tyrannosaurus Rex! Tyrannosaurus Rex! That's right!
words.exZh: 这是霸王龙！霸王龙！答对了！

words.ex: Oh, this is a brontosaurus! Brontosaurus! Yes!
words.exZh: 哦，这是雷龙！雷龙！是的！

words.ex: And this is a triceratops! Triceratops! Well done, George! George loves dinosaurs.
words.exZh: 还有这是三角龙！三角龙！真棒，乔治！乔治喜欢恐龙。

words.ex: All right, you old sea dog, race you! Prepare to lose, water hog!
words.exZh: 好吧，你这老水狗，跟你比一场！准备认输吧，水耗子！

words.ex: The Playground. Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends.
words.exZh: 游乐场。佩奇和乔治和朋友们在游乐场。

words.ex: Daddy's tummy is just like a bouncy castle! George loves bouncing on Daddy's tummy. George isn't afraid of heights any more!
words.exZh: 爸爸的肚子就像一座充气城堡！乔治喜欢在爸爸的肚子上蹦。乔治再也不怕高啦！

words.ex: It's not funny! Well, it does look a bit funny. We'll have to pull you out! Peppa's friends are helping to free her. Hooray! Thank you, everyone!
words.exZh: 这一点都不好笑！嗯，不过看起来确实有点好笑。我们得把你拉出来！佩奇的朋友们在帮忙把她弄出来。太好啦！谢谢大家！

words.ex: Hey presto! Another sandcastle! Peppa, George, home time! Don't leave any stuff behind! Let's check that we haven't forgotten anything. Towels, beach bag, sunshade, and the spotty ball. That's everything!
words.exZh: 嘿，变！又一座沙堡！佩奇，乔治，该回家啦！别落下东西！我们检查一下有没有忘带什么。浴巾、沙滩包、遮阳伞，还有圆点球。全齐了！

words.ex: Maybe you should go a little slower, Grandpa Pig! Good idea, Granny Pig, I don't want to use up all my petrol!

words.ex: Ahoy there, Granddad Dog! Ahoy there, Grandpa Pig! Hello, Danny!
words.exZh: 你好啊，狗爷爷！你好啊，猪爷爷！你好，丹尼！

words.ex: This old boat can go faster than your rusty bucket any day, Grandpa Pig!
words.exZh: 猪爷爷，我这艘老船哪天都比你那艘锈桶跑得快！

words.ex: Oh, never mind, George, you can choose the fruit! Where is the fruit? Over there! There are apples and oranges and bananas and a very big melon. What fruit shall we have, George? Apples? Oranges? Bananas? A melon!

words.ex: Okay, Susie, here are three balls: a red one, a blue one, and a yellow one! Okay! Okay! You have to secretly choose one while my back is turned. Okay! Have you chosen one? Yes! Abracadabra! You chose yellow! No! Uh... abracadabra! Blue! No! Abracadabra! Red! Yes! It is red! Hooray!
words.exZh: 好的，苏西，这里有三个球：一个红的、一个蓝的，还有一个黄的！好的！好的！趁我背过身去，你要偷偷选一个。好的！你选好了吗？选好了！阿布拉卡达布拉！你选的是黄色！不对！呃……阿布拉卡达布拉！蓝色！不对！阿布拉卡达布拉！红色！对啦！就是红色！太好啦！
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Silly magic Daddy, you said all three colours! Shush, Peppa, don't tell anyone!

words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：我的生日派对

words.ex: Oh, but George and I want to do some dancing! I know what we can do! We can watch some television! Oh, it won't go on! The TV needs electricity, too! Does it? Yes!

words.ex: Oh! The electricity is back! Hooray! Hooray! Shush! I haven't finished yet! Switch the lights off! Okay, Peppa!
words.exZh: 哦！电回来了！太好啦！太好啦！嘘！我还没讲完呢！把灯关掉！好的，佩奇！

words.ex: Oh, we'd better tell Daddy we found the torch! Daddy is still in the cellar, looking for the torch. I'm sure it's here somewhere! Where?
words.exZh: 哦，我们最好告诉爸爸我们找到手电筒了！爸爸还在地窖里找手电筒呢。我肯定它就在这儿的什么地方！在哪儿？

words.ex: Oh, I just remembered, I think the torch is in the kitchen!
words.exZh: 哦，我想起来了，手电筒好像在厨房里！

words.exZh: 哦，标签上写的是给佩奇和乔治的！妈妈你看，是给乔治和我的包裹！

words.ex: We've got baskets for the apples and buckets for the blackberries! First, the easy bit: picking apples! On the count of three, shake the tree! One, two...

words.ex: It is Susie Sheep! Hello, Peppa! Hello, Susie! My mummy is in a blackberry bush, and she'll be there for a hundred years, like Sleeping Beauty! And she'll be rescued by a handsome prince who will give her a kiss!
words.exZh: 是小羊苏西！你好，佩奇！你好，苏西！我妈妈在黑莓丛里，她要在那儿待一百年，就像睡美人一样！而且会有一位英俊的王子来救她，还会给她一个吻！

words.ex: My mummy is having an adventure! I wish my mummy would have adventures like that!
words.exZh: 我妈妈正在经历一场冒险呢！我希望我妈妈也能有这样的冒险！

words.ex: And then Mummy fell in the bush! She looked quite silly, and she was going, "Ah! Help me! Help me!" And then Daddy came and rescued her! The end!
words.exZh: 然后妈妈掉进了灌木丛里！她看起来傻乎乎的，还一直喊着「啊！救命！救命！」然后爸爸来把她救了出来！故事讲完啦！

words.ex: Do Granny and Grandpa like antiques? What does antique mean? Antique means old and rare! Usually, yes! But my antiques are brand new! That chair comes in a set of twelve! Nice, isn't it? Is it made of oak? Yes, it's made of plastic oak! Is it comfortable? You mustn't sit on it! Antique chairs are not for sitting on! So, what do you do with them? You look at them! words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Sometimes Daddy Pig loses his glasses. Peppa, George, have you seen Daddy Pig's glasses? He can't find them anywhere.
words.exZh: 有时候猪爸爸会弄丢眼镜。佩奇，乔治，你们看见猪爸爸的眼镜了吗？他到处都找不到。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: This is ridiculous! I can't see anything! Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
words.exZh: 太荒唐了！我什么都看不见！一定有人把我的眼镜放到别的地方去了。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: When I don't wear them, I always put them in my pocket. But they aren't there now.
words.exZh: 我不戴的时候，总是把它们放进口袋里。可现在不在那儿。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: George, be careful not to knock anything over. It's not funny.
words.exZh: 乔治，小心别把东西碰倒了。这可不好笑。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Peppa looks under the pillows, but Daddy Pig's glasses are not there.
words.exZh: 佩奇在枕头底下找，但猪爸爸的眼镜不在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: George looks in Daddy's slippers, but the glasses are not there either.
words.exZh: 乔治在爸爸的拖鞋里找，眼镜也不在那里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: The glasses are not in the toilet.
words.exZh: 眼镜也不在马桶里。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: I suppose I'll just have to learn to do without them. If I move slowly, I won't bump into things.
words.exZh: 我想我只能学着没有眼镜过日子了。如果我慢慢走，就不会撞到东西。
words.epName: Peppa Pig: Daddy Loses His Glasses
words.epZh: 小猪佩奇：爸爸丢了眼镜

words.ex: Grandpa, what are you doing? I'm planting these seeds.
words.exZh: 爷爷，你在做什么？我在种这些种子。

words.ex: Seeds grow into plants.
words.exZh: 种子会长成植物。

words.ex: After many days, Grandpa Pig finds a tiny plant growing.
words.exZh: 许多天以后，猪爷爷发现长出了一株小苗。

words.ex: George drank his juice too quickly, and now he has hiccups.
words.exZh: 乔治果汁喝得太快，现在他打嗝了。

words.ex: George, please stop hiccupping!
words.exZh: 乔治，别打嗝了！

words.ex: Oh dear, George's hiccups are spoiling the game.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪，乔治打嗝把游戏都弄糟了。

words.ex: First, jump up and down three times on one leg.
words.exZh: 首先，单脚跳三下。

words.ex: I know how to cure hiccups. The ill piggy must be given a shock.
words.exZh: 我知道怎么治打嗝了。得让生病的小猪受点惊吓。

words.ex: I know how to cure hiccups. The ill piggy must be given a shock.
words.exZh: 我知道怎么治打嗝了。得让生病的小猪受点惊吓。

words.ex: George, I'm going to scare you. But you must remember it's only a game, and it'll stop your hiccups.
words.exZh: 乔治，我要吓你一跳。但你要记住这只是个游戏，这样你的嗝就会停。

words.ex: Peppa, you mustn't play so roughly with George. He's only little.
words.exZh: 佩奇，你不能跟乔治玩得这么粗鲁。他还小呢。

words.ex: Here comes Daddy Pig with two beakers of juice.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸拿着两杯果汁过来了。

words.ex: Pumpkins are the only thing I can grow. Probably because I love pumpkin pie.
words.exZh: 南瓜是我唯一能种出来的东西。大概是因为我太喜欢南瓜派了。

words.ex: George is riding his tricycle. He's going so slowly.
words.exZh: 乔治骑着他的三轮车。他骑得好慢。

words.ex: Peppa and her friends are racing to Daddy Pig's pumpkin.
words.exZh: 佩奇和她的朋友们正朝猪爸爸的南瓜骑去。

words.ex: Peppa wishes she did not have stabilizers on her bicycle.
words.exZh: 佩奇真希望自己的自行车上没有辅助轮。

words.ex: You're doing really well, Peppa. Hold on, Daddy. Just keep pedaling.
words.exZh: 你做得非常好，佩奇。抓紧，爸爸。继续踩踏板。

words.ex: Daddy, you let go! You've been cycling on your own for ages.
words.exZh: 爸爸，你松手了！你已经自己骑了好久了。

words.ex: Oh, I can do it! Look at me. Look at me. I can ride my bike properly.
words.exZh: 哦，我会骑了！看着我。看着我。我能好好骑车了。

words.ex: In future, you really must look where you are going. I promise I will, Daddy.
words.exZh: 以后你真的要看清楚路。我保证我会的，爸爸。

words.ex: It's very nice, Peppa. What's inside? It's a secret. George tried to guess, but he didn't get it right. Can I have a try?
words.exZh: 非常漂亮，佩奇。里面是什么呢？是秘密。乔治猜过了，但没猜对。我能试试吗？

words.ex: And that's all your guesses used up. Peppa likes secrets. Hmm, no one knows what's in my box. Oh, what has George got?
words.exZh: 你的猜测机会都用完了。佩奇喜欢秘密。嗯，没人知道我盒子里有什么。哦，乔治拿的是什么？

words.ex: Maybe if you showed George one thing from your box, then he could show you one thing from his.
words.exZh: 也许你给乔治看你盒子里的一件东西，他也会给你看他盒子里的一件东西。

words.ex: Okay, but we must do it at the same time. That's a good idea. On the count of three, you each show what's in your boxes. Ready? Yes!
words.exZh: 好吧，但我们必须同时打开。这是个好主意。数到三，你们各自亮出盒子里的东西。准备好了吗？好了！

words.ex: George has a drum, and Peppa has a trumpet. Oh, lovely. Yes, it sounds very nice.
words.exZh: 乔治有一面鼓，佩奇有一只小号。哦，真好听。是的，听起来非常好听。

words.ex: George, Peppa, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig all like custard donuts.
words.exZh: 乔治、佩奇、猪妈妈和猪爸爸都喜欢奶油甜甜圈。

words.ex: I don't have a special box, but I know a very good place to hide my custard donut. Can you guess where? Hmm. Are you going to hide it in the fridge?
words.exZh: 我没有特别的盒子，但我知道一个藏奶油甜甜圈的好地方。你们能猜到是哪儿吗？嗯。你要把它藏在冰箱里吗？

words.ex: Flying a Kite. It is a bright, sunny day. Peppa and her family are in the park. They are going to fly a kite.
words.exZh: 放风筝。今天阳光明媚。佩奇和家人在公园里。他们要去放风筝。

words.ex: Oh, we just have to wait until the wind picks up a bit. Look, it's getting windy. Now that it is windy, the kite can fly.
words.exZh: 哦，我们只要等风大一点就行。看，起风了。现在有风了，风筝就能飞了。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you are much too heavy for that branch! Nonsense, I know exactly how heavy I am.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，那根树枝可承受不了你的重量！胡说，我清楚自己有多重。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you are much too heavy for that branch! Nonsense, I know exactly how heavy I am.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，那根树枝可承受不了你的重量！胡说，我清楚自己有多重。

words.ex: I suppose so. After all, you can't get any muddier. And I think Daddy Pig is going to be doing the washing.
words.exZh: 我想可以吧。反正你们也不会更脏了。而且我觉得猪爸爸得负责洗衣服了。

words.ex: Daddy Pig is bringing the picnic basket. Picnic blanket, bread, cheese, tomatoes and lemonade. Is there anything we've forgotten?
words.exZh: 猪爸爸提着野餐篮。野餐垫、面包、奶酪、西红柿和柠檬水。我们有没有忘了什么？

words.ex: This looks like just the spot for our picnic.
words.exZh: 这里看起来正是野餐的好地方。

words.ex: Ah, it's great to be outdoors. We should run around a bit and get some exercise.
words.exZh: 啊，在户外真舒服。我们应该跑一跑，锻炼锻炼身体。

words.ex: I want to eat, then have a nap. I certainly don't want to run around.
words.exZh: 我想吃东西，然后睡个午觉。我可不想跑来跑去。

words.ex: Peppa and George love feeding bread to ducks.
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢喂鸭子吃面包。

words.ex: Oh, a wasp! I hate wasps. Shoo! What a fuss, Mummy Pig. It's only a little wasp. Go away, wasp!
words.exZh: 哦，一只黄蜂！我讨厌黄蜂。嘘！猪妈妈，真大惊小怪。只是一只小黄蜂。走开，黄蜂！

words.ex: Oh, a wasp! I hate wasps. Shoo! What a fuss, Mummy Pig. It's only a little wasp. Go away, wasp!
words.exZh: 哦，一只黄蜂！我讨厌黄蜂。嘘！猪妈妈，真大惊小怪。只是一只小黄蜂。走开，黄蜂！

words.ex: Okay, get away! Scram!
words.exZh: 好吧，走开！快滚！

words.ex: I hope the wasp doesn't sting Daddy. Oh, get away, you little pest!
words.exZh: 希望黄蜂别蜇到爸爸。哦，走开，你这个小讨厌鬼！

words.ex: I hope the wasp doesn't sting Daddy. Oh, get away, you little pest!

words.ex: Luckily I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
words.exZh: 幸好我总算保住了我那块草莓蛋糕。

words.ex: Luckily I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
words.exZh: 幸好我总算保住了我那块草莓蛋糕。

words.ex: Stop, Daddy! We promised the rest of the cake for the ducks.
words.exZh: 停下，爸爸！我们答应过把剩下的蛋糕给鸭子的。

words.ex: Oh. You're very lucky.
words.exZh: 哦。你们可真走运。

words.ex: Mummy Pig and I found this old box in the attic. Can anyone guess what's inside? Hmm? Nope. It's full of musical instruments.
words.exZh: 我和猪妈妈在阁楼上发现了这个旧箱子。有人能猜到里面是什么吗？嗯？猜不到。里面装满了乐器。

words.ex: Wow! They are a bit old and dusty.
words.exZh: 哇！它们有点旧，还满是灰尘。

words.ex: This is the violin I used to play when I was little. Mummy, can you play your violin? I haven't played it for a long time.
words.exZh: 这是我小时候拉的小提琴。妈妈，你能拉小提琴吗？我已经很久没拉了。

words.ex: Bravo! Yay!
words.exZh: 太棒了！好耶！

words.ex: Peppa, maybe you would do better with this tin drum. Thank you, Daddy.
words.exZh: 佩奇，也许你用这个铁皮鼓会好一些。谢谢你，爸爸。

words.ex: This is Daddy Pig's old accordion. I used to play this to Mummy Pig when we first met.
words.exZh: 这是猪爸爸的旧手风琴。我和猪妈妈刚认识的时候，常常拉给她听。

words.ex: Oh, Daddy Pig, I remember this tune.
words.exZh: 哦，猪爸爸，我记得这首曲子。

words.ex: That does not sound right. It's impossible. I think I used to be able to play it.
words.exZh: 这个听起来不对。这根本不可能。我记得我以前会吹的。

words.ex: Never mind, Daddy Pig, just stick to the accordion. You play it beautifully.
words.exZh: 没关系，猪爸爸，你还是拉手风琴吧。你拉得非常动听。

words.ex: Well, I do play it quite nicely, even if I say so myself. And I'll play my violin. And I will play my drum.
words.exZh: 嗯，我拉得确实挺不错的，虽然是我自己说的。那我拉小提琴。我打我的鼓。

words.ex: But what instrument will George play?
words.exZh: 那乔治要演奏什么乐器呢？

words.ex: George is blowing the horn. Mummy couldn't play the horn, and Daddy couldn't play it, and even I couldn't play it. But George can play it.
words.exZh: 乔治在吹号角。妈妈吹不响，爸爸也吹不响，连我都吹不响。可是乔治会吹。

words.ex: They have very long tongues. Look at mine.
words.exZh: 它们的舌头很长。看看我的。

words.ex: Dressing Up. Peppa and George are playing in Mummy and Daddy's bedroom.
words.exZh: 装扮游戏。佩奇和乔治在猪爸爸和猪妈妈的卧室里玩。

words.ex: Here is Daddy's hat, and here is Daddy's coat. Hello, Daddy Pig.
words.exZh: 这是爸爸的帽子，这是爸爸的外套。你好，猪爸爸。

words.ex: Peppa has found Mummy's makeup box. Aha! First, some powder. Lovely!

words.exZh: 佩奇找到了妈妈的化妆盒。啊哈！先扑点粉。真好看！

words.ex: Now for some lipstick. What a pretty Mummy Pig!
words.exZh: 现在涂点口红。多漂亮的猪妈妈呀！

words.ex: Peppa, I was just saying hello. I'm not Peppa Pig. I'm Mummy Pig. Oh, yes, of course. Hello, Mummy Pig.

words.exZh: 抱歉，我有很多工作要做。

words.ex: That's very kind of you, Daddy Pig. Now, be careful, it's a very deep hole.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你真是太好了。现在小心点，这个洞很深。

words.ex: I want to make big snorts.
words.exZh: 我也想大声哼哼。

words.ex: You really had us fooled.
words.exZh: 你们真的把我们骗到了。

words.ex: Oh! Daddy Pig is looking in the wheelbarrow. Peppa's shoes are not there.
words.exZh: 哦！猪爸爸在手推车里找。佩奇的鞋子不在那儿。

words.ex: Oh! Peppa and George look in the flower pots. Peppa's shoes are not there, either.
words.exZh: 哦！佩奇和乔治在花盆里找。佩奇的鞋子也不在那儿。

words.ex: Poor Peppa. Your shoes were getting a bit old. We'll buy you a new pair. Can my new shoes be red, Mummy? Of course they can.
words.exZh: 可怜的佩奇。你的鞋子有点旧了。我们给你买双新的吧。妈妈，我的新鞋可以是红色的吗？当然可以。

words.ex: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Miss Rabbit's Shoe Shop. Hello, Miss Rabbit. Hello, Mummy Pig. We would like to buy some new shoes for Peppa, please. Red shoes.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈和佩奇来到兔子小姐的鞋店。你好，兔子小姐。你好，猪妈妈。我们想给佩奇买双新鞋。红色的鞋。

words.ex: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Miss Rabbit's Shoe Shop. Hello, Miss Rabbit. Hello, Mummy Pig. We would like to buy some new shoes for Peppa, please. Red shoes.
words.exZh: 猪妈妈和佩奇来到兔子小姐的鞋店。你好，兔子小姐。你好，猪妈妈。我们想给佩奇买双新鞋。红色的鞋。

words.ex: Peppa is in her pyjamas. She still has her new shoes on.
words.exZh: 佩奇穿上了睡衣。她还穿着新鞋。

words.ex: Peppa is putting on her boots. Wee!
words.exZh: 佩奇穿上了她的靴子。哇！

words.ex: Maybe we can get you a dinosaur balloon. Are you sure they have dinosaur balloons, Daddy Pig? I'm certain of it.
words.exZh: 也许我们可以给你弄一个恐龙气球。猪爸爸，你确定他们有恐龙气球吗？我敢肯定。

words.ex: Oh, dear. I don't know how to do elephants. I can do tigers. Yes, a tiger, please.
words.exZh: 哦，天哪。我不知道怎么画大象。我会画老虎。好的，那就画老虎吧。

words.ex: Because tigers are big cats. And I'm a cat.
words.exZh: 因为老虎是大猫。而我是猫。

words.ex: But best of all, when tigers are happy, they purr.
words.exZh: 不过最棒的是，老虎高兴的时候会发出呼噜声。

words.ex: Can I have a kangaroo? A lion, please. A monkey, please. A parrot, please.
words.exZh: 我可以要袋鼠吗？请给我狮子。请给我猴子。请给我鹦鹉。

words.ex: Can I have a kangaroo? A lion, please. A monkey, please. A parrot, please.
words.exZh: 我可以要袋鼠吗？请给我狮子。请给我猴子。请给我鹦鹉。

words.ex: Daddy Pig has made Mummy Pig breakfast in bed. Happy birthday, Mummy Pig. Peppa and George have made Mummy Pig a birthday card. Happy birthday, Mummy.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸给猪妈妈做了床上早餐。生日快乐，猪妈妈。佩奇和乔治给猪妈妈做了一张生日卡片。妈妈，生日快乐。

words.ex: Oh, what a lovely birthday surprise. And there are more surprises to come. Enjoy your birthday breakfast. Take your time.
words.exZh: 哦，多么可爱的生日惊喜。还有更多惊喜等着你呢。好好享用你的生日早餐。别着急。

words.ex: Mummy's coming. Oh no, we're not ready yet. Uh, who is it? It's Mummy. Can I come in? No. No. Is there something secret going on? Uh, no. Nothing's going on. But you can't come in.
words.exZh: 妈妈来了。哦不，我们还没准备好。呃，谁呀？是妈妈。我可以进来吗？不行。不行。是不是有什么秘密的事？呃，没有。什么都没有。但是你不能进来。

words.ex: I see. Mummy Pig, why don't you relax in the sitting room? That sounds nice. Well, it is your birthday.
words.exZh: 我明白了。猪妈妈，你去客厅休息一下好吗？听起来不错。嗯，今天是你生日嘛。

words.ex: Okay, Peppa, I think I know where the sitting room is. Here's a nice magazine. Thank you, Peppa. And here's some pretty music. Thank you, Peppa.
words.exZh: 好吧，佩奇，我想我知道客厅在哪里。这儿有一本好看的杂志。谢谢你，佩奇。还有好听的音乐。谢谢你，佩奇。

words.ex: We need the same number of candles as Mummy's age. One, two, three. Oh dear, we haven't got nearly enough candles. Daddy, how old is Mummy? I'll whisper it in your ear. Wow, really old.
words.exZh: 我们需要和妈妈年龄一样多的蜡烛。一、二、三。哦，天哪，我们的蜡烛远远不够。爸爸，妈妈多少岁了？我悄悄告诉你。哇，好老啊。

words.ex: We need the same number of candles as Mummy's age. One, two, three. Oh dear, we haven't got nearly enough candles. Daddy, how old is Mummy? I'll whisper it in your ear. Wow, really old.
words.exZh: 我们需要和妈妈年龄一样多的蜡烛。一、二、三。哦，天哪，我们的蜡烛远远不够。爸爸，妈妈多少岁了？我悄悄告诉你。哇，好老啊。

words.ex: We need the same number of candles as Mummy's age. One, two, three. Oh dear, we haven't got nearly enough candles. Daddy, how old is Mummy? I'll whisper it in your ear. Wow, really old.
words.exZh: 我们需要和妈妈年龄一样多的蜡烛。一、二、三。哦，天哪，我们的蜡烛远远不够。爸爸，妈妈多少岁了？我悄悄告诉你。哇，好老啊。

words.ex: You know, I think three candles will be fine. Mummy Pig's birthday cake is ready. Hooray! We just have to put up the decorations in the sitting room.
words.exZh: 你知道吗，我觉得三根蜡烛就够了。猪妈妈的生日蛋糕做好了。太好啦！我们只要在客厅挂上装饰就行了。

words.ex: I've forgotten what hard work birthdays were.
words.exZh: 我都忘了过生日是这么辛苦的事。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, Peppa, and George are decorating the sitting room.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸、佩奇和乔治在装饰客厅。

words.ex: Mummy, would you like to come inside now? I'd love to. Close your eyes. Keep your eyes closed, Mummy.
words.exZh: 妈妈，你现在想进来吗？非常想。闭上眼睛。妈妈，眼睛要一直闭着哦。

words.ex: What a super birthday. I'm the luckiest Mummy in the whole world and the most beautiful.
words.exZh: 多么棒的生日。我是全世界最幸运的妈妈，也是最漂亮的妈妈。

words.ex: What a super birthday. I'm the luckiest Mummy in the whole world and the most beautiful.
words.exZh: 多么棒的生日。我是全世界最幸运的妈妈，也是最漂亮的妈妈。

words.ex: Finished. Ah, now we'll have a bit of quiet.
words.exZh: 吃完了。啊，现在总算能安静一会儿了。

words.ex: Oh, it's my tooth. It's falling out.
words.exZh: 哦，是我的牙。它要掉了。

words.ex: Don't worry, Peppa. It's just a milk tooth. They're meant to fall out. Will I grow a new one, Mummy? Yes, you will, Peppa. It also means the Tooth Fairy will be paying you a visit.
words.exZh: 别担心，佩奇。这只是乳牙。乳牙本来就是要掉的。妈妈，我还会长新牙吗？会的，佩奇。这也意味着牙仙会来看你哦。

words.ex: Before going to bed, Peppa and George brush their teeth. Peppa, what are you doing? I'm brushing my tooth so it's nice and clean for the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 睡觉前，佩奇和乔治在刷牙。佩奇，你在做什么？我在刷我的牙，好让它干干净净地给牙仙。

words.ex: Before going to bed, Peppa and George brush their teeth. Peppa, what are you doing? I'm brushing my tooth so it's nice and clean for the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 睡觉前，佩奇和乔治在刷牙。佩奇，你在做什么？我在刷我的牙，好让它干干净净地给牙仙。

words.ex: This Tooth Fairy is very late. The Tooth Fairy is taking a long, long time to arrive. Where is that Tooth Fairy?
words.exZh: 这个牙仙来得真晚。牙仙花了好久好久才到。那个牙仙到底在哪儿？

words.ex: George is not very good at staying awake. But I am. I'm going to stay awake and see the Tooth Fairy.
words.exZh: 乔治不太擅长熬夜。不过我可以。我要一直醒着，看看牙仙。

words.ex: The Tooth Fairy has arrived, but Peppa is asleep. Hello, Peppa. Would you like this coin in return for your tooth?
words.exZh: 牙仙来了，可佩奇睡着了。你好，佩奇。你愿意用这颗牙换这枚硬币吗？

words.ex: What's wrong, Daddy? Uh, I don't know. Let's take it to Grandad Dog's garage. He can fix it. That's a good idea, Mummy Pig.
words.exZh: 爸爸，怎么了？呃，我不知道。我们把它送到狗爷爷的修理厂去吧。他能修好。猪妈妈，这是个好主意。

words.ex: Grandad Dog runs the garage. He is very good at mending cars.
words.exZh: 狗爷爷经营着修理厂。他非常擅长修车。

words.ex: Grandad Dog runs the garage. He is very good at mending cars.
words.exZh: 狗爷爷经营着修理厂。他非常擅长修车。

words.ex: Hooray. Thank you, Grandad Dog. Would you like the roof down? Yes, please. I'll just press this red button.
words.exZh: 太好啦。谢谢你，狗爷爷。你们想把车篷打开吗？好呀。我按一下这个红色按钮。

words.ex: Peppa and her family like the new blue car. There are so many buttons in this new car. What does the green button do, Daddy? Let's see.
words.exZh: 佩奇一家很喜欢这辆新的蓝色汽车。这辆新车里有好多按钮。爸爸，绿色按钮是做什么的？我们来看看。

words.ex: I love this new car. Can we keep it? No, we can't keep it, Peppa. We've only borrowed it for today.
words.exZh: 我喜欢这辆新车。我们能留下它吗？不行，佩奇，我们不能留下它。我们只是借用一天。

words.ex: Whoops. Silly me. Aha. This must be the button.
words.exZh: 哎呀。我真是傻。啊哈。这个肯定是那个按钮。

words.ex: The new car has squirted Daddy Pig with water. Silly Daddy. That's not the roof.
words.exZh: 新车朝猪爸爸喷了水。傻爸爸。那不是车篷按钮。

words.ex: Daddy Pig has forgotten which button closes the roof. I don't think this car likes me. Let's try the red button. Hooray.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸忘了哪个按钮是关车篷的。我觉得这辆车不喜欢我。我们试试红色按钮吧。太好啦。

words.ex: Granny Pig is drawing the treasure map.
words.exZh: 猪奶奶在画藏宝图。

words.ex: Peppa, George, we've made you a treasure hunt. Somewhere in the garden is buried treasure.
words.exZh: 佩奇，乔治，我们给你们准备了一个寻宝游戏。花园里的某个地方埋着宝藏。

words.ex: The map is a bit difficult. Daddy, can you help? Of course, Peppa. I'm very good with maps. Uh, it is a bit difficult.
words.exZh: 这张地图有点难。爸爸，你能帮忙吗？当然可以，佩奇。我特别擅长看地图。呃，它确实有点难。

words.ex: Daddy Pig, you're holding the map upside down! Yes, I thought as much.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你把地图拿反了！是的，我也觉得是。

words.ex: It's easy. See, the red cross shows where the treasure is. But where in the garden are those two apple trees? Hmm, I don't know. Would you like a clue? Yes, please.
words.exZh: 这很简单。看，红色的叉就是宝藏的位置。可是花园里的那两棵苹果树在哪儿呢？嗯，我不知道。你们想要个提示吗？想！

words.ex: The pirate's handwriting is excellent! No, I can't make it out at all.
words.exZh: 海盗的字写得棒极了！不对，我根本看不出来。

words.ex: The pirate has clearly written: follow the arrows.
words.exZh: 海盗写得清清楚楚：跟着箭头走。

words.ex: George has found the second clue: sticks in the shape of an arrow. Look, they point this way.
words.exZh: 乔治找到了第二条线索：摆成箭头形状的树枝。看，它们指向这边。

words.ex: George has found the second clue: sticks in the shape of an arrow. Look, they point this way.
words.exZh: 乔治找到了第二条线索：摆成箭头形状的树枝。看，它们指向这边。

words.ex: Peppa and George are following the arrows. Look, George, a key!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治跟着箭头走。乔治你看，一把钥匙！

words.ex: Peppa has found the next clue: a key! Well done, Peppa! Now you just have to find the treasure chest that it unlocks.
words.exZh: 佩奇找到了下一条线索：一把钥匙！干得好，佩奇！现在你们只要找到它能打开的宝箱就行了。

words.ex: But there aren't any more clues. Maybe you should take another look at the map.
words.exZh: 可是没有别的线索了。也许你们该再看看那张地图。

words.ex: I've got the key to open it. Wow! I can't believe it! Gold coins! They must be worth a fortune!
words.exZh: 我有打开它的钥匙。哇！我简直不敢相信！金币！它们一定值一大笔钱！

words.ex: I've got the key to open it. Wow! I can't believe it! Gold coins! They must be worth a fortune!
words.exZh: 我有打开它的钥匙。哇！我简直不敢相信！金币！它们一定值一大笔钱！

words.ex: Dr. Brown Bear speaking. Peppa is not very well. Her face is covered in red spots. Hmm. Put Peppa to bed, and I'll come straight round.
words.exZh: 我是棕熊医生。佩奇不太舒服。她脸上全是红色的斑点。嗯。让佩奇上床休息，我马上就过来。

words.ex: Dr. Brown Bear speaking. Peppa is not very well. Her face is covered in red spots. Hmm. Put Peppa to bed, and I'll come straight round.
words.exZh: 我是棕熊医生。佩奇不太舒服。她脸上全是红色的斑点。嗯。让佩奇上床休息，我马上就过来。

words.ex: Hmm, it's not anything serious. Peppa has just got a rash. Do I need medicine? The rash will clear up quickly, but if you like, I can give you just a little medicine.
words.exZh: 嗯，不严重。佩奇只是起了疹子。我需要吃药吗？疹子很快就会消退，不过如果你愿意，我可以给你开一点点药。

words.ex: Hmm, it's not anything serious. Peppa has just got a rash. Do I need medicine? The rash will clear up quickly, but if you like, I can give you just a little medicine.
words.exZh: 嗯，不严重。佩奇只是起了疹子。我需要吃药吗？疹子很快就会消退，不过如果你愿意，我可以给你开一点点药。

words.ex: I'm afraid it doesn't taste very nice. Open wide, please.
words.exZh: 恐怕这药不太好吃。请把嘴张大。

words.ex: Disgusting! You are a brave little one for taking it so well.
words.exZh: 太难吃了！你真是个勇敢的小家伙，这么乖就把药吃了。

words.ex: Suzy Sheep is Peppa's best friend. I'll ring Suzy Sheep's Mummy.
words.exZh: 小羊苏西是佩奇最好的朋友。我给苏西的妈妈打电话。

words.ex: Hello, Mrs. Pig. May Peppa talk with Suzy, please?
words.exZh: 你好，猪太太。请问佩奇能和苏西说说话吗？

words.ex: Yes, yes, it's not pretend. I have to stay in bed. Dr. Brown Bear gave me medicine that tasted really horrible.
words.exZh: 是的，是的，不是装的。我得卧床休息。棕熊医生给我开的药特别难吃。

words.ex: Yes, yes, it's not pretend. I have to stay in bed. Dr. Brown Bear gave me medicine that tasted really horrible.
words.exZh: 是的，是的，不是装的。我得卧床休息。棕熊医生给我开的药特别难吃。

words.ex: I'm coming to see you! I'm going to wear my nurse's outfit.
words.exZh: 我这就来看你！我要穿上我的护士服。

words.ex: I fancy a game with this ball in the garden. Who wants to join me? Me! Me! Me! Me, too!
words.exZh: 我想去花园里玩这个球。谁要一起玩？我！我！我！我也要！

words.ex: Well, I never. A complete recovery!
words.exZh: 哎呀，真没想到。完全康复啦！

words.ex: Well, I never. A complete recovery!
words.exZh: 哎呀，真没想到。完全康复啦！

words.ex: Snow. Peppa and George are very excited today. It is snowing outside. Mummy, can we go and play in the snow?
words.exZh: 下雪了。佩奇和乔治今天特别兴奋。外面下雪了。妈妈，我们能去雪地里玩吗？

words.ex: Snow. Peppa and George are very excited today. It is snowing outside. Mummy, can we go and play in the snow?
words.exZh: 下雪了。佩奇和乔治今天特别兴奋。外面下雪了。妈妈，我们能去雪地里玩吗？

words.ex: Yes, but it's very cold outside, so you must wrap up warm.
words.exZh: 可以，不过外面很冷，你们得穿暖和些。

words.ex: George, let's play snowballs!
words.exZh: 乔治，我们来打雪仗吧！

words.ex: Peppa has made a snowball. Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
words.exZh: 佩奇团了一个雪球。佩奇和乔治玩得非常开心。

words.ex: George, come back, you little piggy! Oh, dear. Maybe this game is getting a little too rough. Sorry, George.
words.exZh: 乔治，你回来，你这个小猪！哦，天哪。也许这个游戏玩得有点过火了。对不起，乔治。

words.ex: George, let's build a snowman!
words.exZh: 乔治，我们来堆雪人吧！

words.ex: George has found some sticks for the snowman's arms. Peppa has found some stones for the snowman's eyes and mouth.
words.exZh: 乔治找了一些树枝当雪人的手臂。佩奇找了一些石头当雪人的眼睛和嘴巴。

words.ex: Peppa, George, today we're going to Windy Castle. What's Windy Castle, Daddy? It's a castle on a very high hill. George likes castles.
words.exZh: 佩奇，乔治，今天我们要去风车城堡。爸爸，风车城堡是什么？它是一座建在高高山上的城堡。乔治喜欢城堡。

words.ex: Daddy Pig has to secretly look at something, and the others have to guess what it is. I spy with my little eye something colored red. Red?
words.exZh: 猪爸爸要偷偷看着一样东西，其他人来猜那是什么。我用我的小眼睛看见了，一样红色的东西。红色的？

words.ex: Hmm, George's blue shirt? Nope. Is it something in the car? No. Give up? Yes. The sky! The blue sky!
words.exZh: 嗯，是乔治的蓝衬衫吗？不是。是车里的东西吗？不是。放弃了吗？放弃了。是天空！蓝色的天空！

words.ex: I win! Daddy Pig, do you know where we are? I know exactly where we are. Although this road doesn't look the same as it does on the map.
words.exZh: 我赢啦！猪爸爸，你知道我们在哪儿吗？我完全知道我们在哪儿。虽然这条路看起来和地图上不太一样。

words.ex: This is the best route: keep on the main road until you see Windy Castle up ahead. Thank you, Grandpa Pig.
words.exZh: 这是最好的路线：沿着大路一直走，直到你看见前面的风车城堡。谢谢你，猪爷爷。

words.ex: Wow, it's so tall. Let's go inside. The view from the top is fantastic.
words.exZh: 哇，它好高啊。我们进去吧。从顶上看出去的风景美极了。

words.ex: Got you! I win! You moved before I was ready. The rules say I can move when I like, don't they, George?
words.exZh: 抓到你啦！我赢了！我还没准备好你就动了。规则说我什么时候想动就什么时候动，对吧，乔治？

words.ex: Pancakes. It is teatime, and Mummy Pig has a surprise for everyone.
words.exZh: 薄煎饼。下午茶时间到了，猪妈妈给大家准备了一个惊喜。

words.ex: Are you sure, Daddy Pig? Last time you got a bit grumpy when you dropped the pancake on the floor. I did not get grumpy. There was a problem with the frying pan.
words.exZh: 猪爸爸，你确定吗？上次你把煎饼掉在地上，就有点发脾气了。我才没有发脾气。是那个平底锅有问题。

words.ex: Are you sure, Daddy Pig? Last time you got a bit grumpy when you dropped the pancake on the floor. I did not get grumpy. There was a problem with the frying pan.

words.exZh: 你们好，我的小宝贝们！你们好。佩奇，乔治，快上床去！

words.ex: What little darlings. Now go to sleep quickly. Yes, Mummy. So well behaved.
words.exZh: 多可爱的小宝贝呀。现在快点睡觉吧。好的，妈妈。真听话。

words.ex: What little darlings. Now go to sleep quickly. Yes, Mummy. So well behaved.

words.exZh: 什么奇怪的声音。我们要不要上楼去看看。

words.ex: Oh, you seem heavier than before. Now it's George's turn.
words.exZh: 哦，你看起来比以前重了。现在轮到乔治了。

words.ex: No, the dinosaur was very gentle. It ate lots of grass. Daddy Pig! Oh, sorry, I was being the dinosaur.

words.ex: Looking at herself all day in the mirror had completely worn her out. Let's carry you to bed. Good night.

words.ex: Would Teddy or Mr. Dinosaur like a cookie? We're not very hungry, so Peppa and George can eat all the cookies. Thank you, Teddy.

words.ex: Mummy, there was a loud bang! It's thunder, Peppa. It means there will be a thunderstorm with lots of rain. Quick, into the house before the rain starts!
words.exZh: 妈妈，刚才有一声巨响！佩奇，那是打雷。这意味着要下雷阵雨了，还有大雨。快点，趁还没下雨进屋去！

words.ex: I know all about thunderstorms. It won't rain for ages. As I thought, plenty of time before it rains.
words.exZh: 我对雷阵雨了如指掌。一时半会儿还下不了雨。果然不出我所料，离下雨还早着呢。

words.exZh: 猪爸爸把车擦得那么亮，他都能在车上看见自己的脸了。多滑稽的一张脸！哦，还有更多滑稽的脸！是佩奇、乔治和猪妈妈！

words.ex: Chocolate cake! My word, George seems to have got his appetite back!
words.exZh: 巧克力蛋糕！哎呀，乔治好像又有胃口了！

words.ex: Don't worry, Peppa, I'm an expert at camping. Mummy Pig, put the tent on the poles, please. That's it, easy as pie.
words.exZh: 别担心，佩奇，我可是露营专家。猪妈妈，请把帐篷套到杆子上。就这样，小菜一碟。

words.ex: Talking of tummies, we should cook supper. Yes, yes! First, we have to collect sticks to make a fire. Yes!
words.exZh: 说到肚子，我们该做晚饭了。对，对！首先，我们得捡些树枝生火。好耶！

words.ex: Peppa and George are helping Daddy Pig collect sticks for the campfire. George, I'll pick up the sticks, and you can carry them. Collecting sticks is fun!
words.exZh: 佩奇和乔治在帮猪爸爸捡树枝生篝火。乔治，我来捡树枝，你来搬。捡树枝真好玩！

words.ex: Good, that's enough sticks. That's a splendid campfire. Now I'll light it.
words.exZh: 好了，树枝够了。这堆篝火真棒。现在我来把它点着。

words.ex: Daddy, how can you light it without matches? I'm going to make fire the old way, by simply rubbing these two sticks together.
words.exZh: 爸爸，没有火柴你怎么点火？我要用最老的办法生火，就是把这两根树枝互相摩擦。

words.ex: Now we can heat up the tomato soup. Ah, listen to the sounds of nature.

words.exZh: 我的肚子咕咕叫是大自然最美妙的声音之一。它意味着该吃饭啦！我喜欢番茄汤。我也是！

words.ex: I love camping: sleeping in the open air with the stars above me. Maybe this wasn't such a good idea after all.

words.ex: It is morning. Daddy, it was lovely and cozy in the tent. Oh, where's Daddy?
words.exZh: 天亮了。爸爸，帐篷里又暖和又舒服。哦，爸爸去哪儿了？
